producers.name: Rafael Palacios
producers.intro: 从 Bibei 河谷的高海拔地块，读懂 Godello 的不同表达。重点比较地块来源、树龄与带皮发酵，而不只记住旗舰酒名。
producers.scope: 4 款详细档案＋1 款历史线索；特殊版本与逐年份资料仍在补齐。

sections.title: 人物与起点
sections.text: Rafael 于 2004 年在 Valdeorras 的 O Bolo 开始个人项目，向当地种植者收购老藤 Godello 地块。研究这家酒庄，先把 Galicia → Valdeorras → Bibei → O Bolo 的地理层级分清。

sections.title: Sortes：地块也是历史
sections.text: 当地的小地块称为 sorte，与过去抽签分配继承土地有关。官网列出的庄园资料为 32 个地块、24.5 公顷 Godello、海拔约 620–740 米；页面未标明统计年份，应视为来源快照而非实时面积。

sections.title: 地理与耕作
sections.text: Bibei 河谷的梯田建立在花岗岩风化砂质土上，兼有石英片岩。土层贫瘠、易侵蚀，酒庄使用适应梯田的轻型设备与畜力耕作。理解风格时，需要同时观察海拔、坡向、土层与成熟度，不能只凭“花岗岩”直接推断某一种香气。

sections.title: 酿造比较：容器与果皮
sections.text: Louro 的官网工艺是 35 hl 大木桶发酵、细酒泥熟成 4 个月；As Sortes 与 O Soro 列为 500 L 桶、8 个月。Antiga 则带皮发酵约一个月、旧桶熟成 12 个月。比较时把容器、酒泥和果皮接触拆开观察，不把所有 Godello 当成相同风格。

sections.title: Valdeorras 项目的起点
sections.text: Beyond Albariño 将 Rafael Palacios 的 Valdeorras 项目放在 2004 年起，以 Bibei 河谷老藤与地块研究推进 Godello 的声誉。

sections.title: Louro、As Sortes 与单园
sections.text: 用户主笔记明确列 Louro、As Sortes Val do Bibei 与 Sorte O Soro；原文强调 Godello 的质感、结构和容器选择，不能仅记“高酸清新白酒”。

sections.title: Bolo 的历史位置
sections.text: 原文解释葡萄价格上升及 2017 年霜冻后，较依赖购入葡萄的入门 Bolo 停止，重心转向自有园。Bolo 恢复为历史酒款，不列为当前系列。

sections.title: 味觉与年份
sections.text: 文章记录不同年份 Louro 可在盲品中呈现近似 Chardonnay／Chablis 的质感，但这是一种比较，不是品种身份或永久风味模板。Godello 的丰满度与酸度应分开评估。

producers.name: Álvaro Palacios
producers.intro: 从 Priorat 的复兴读到村庄与单一地块。把 Camins、Les Terrasses、Gratallops 和几款地块酒放在同一张比较表里，理解每款酒为什么存在。
producers.scope: 本档案覆盖 Priorat 的 7 款核心酒；Rioja 与 Bierzo 相关项目单独列出，尚未完成其独立档案。

sections.title: 人物与酒庄边界
sections.text: 产区官方记载 Álvaro 于 1989 年来到 Gratallops。这里的 Producer 指他的 Priorat 酒庄；Palacios Remondo（Rioja）与 Descendientes de J. Palacios（Bierzo，与侄子 Ricardo 合作）属于相关项目，不混入这份酒款目录。

sections.title: 地块与地方品种
sections.text: Priorat 官方强调 llicorella 地表与陡坡畜力耕作。进口商资料描述其逐渐重视 Garnacha、Carinyena 及园中混植的少量白品种。研究时应按酒款和年份查比例，而非把整家酒庄写成一种固定混酿。

sections.title: 历史节点
sections.text: Vila Viniteca 记载：1989 Clos Dofí；1990 Les Terrasses；1993 购入 L’Ermita 并首度装瓶；2007 推出 Camins 与 Gratallops；2015 Les Aubaguetes；2018 La Baixada。资料有“酿造、收购、上市”口径差别：Gratallops 的 2006 酿造与 2007 推出不能混称首年份。

sections.title: 从区域到地块
sections.text: Camins 是接近 Priorat 的入口；Les Terrasses 呈现多处老藤坡地；Gratallops 聚焦村庄。Finca Dofí、L’Ermita、Les Aubaguetes、La Baixada 则适合逐园比较。这里是教学观察路径，不代替产区的法定分级。

sections.title: 资料冲突也应保留
sections.text: 不同年代资料的自有面积、葡萄比例与产量不同，不能拼成一个“最新数字”。官网入口可确认，但本轮无法读取其技术目录；以下优先用产区官方与已标明的进口商／酒商资料，年度技术参数继续核实。

sections.title: Priorat 复兴与家族分工
sections.text: 原档案把 Álvaro Palacios 列入 1989 年五个 Clos 的复兴核心。Priorat 的酒庄、Alfaro 的 Palacios Remondo、Bierzo 的 Descendientes de J. Palacios 分别属于不同项目，不能只以人的名字合并酒款。

sections.title: 从地区到园址
sections.text: Camins del Priorat、Les Terrasses、Gratallops、Finca Dofí、L’Ermita、Les Aubaguetes、La Baixada 对应不同来源范围与选择。这些名称分别体现区域、村庄与园址的来源范围。

sections.title: 原笔记的年份边界
sections.text: L’Ermita 或 Dofí 的历史 Cabernet / Syrah 组成不等于今天各年份公式。原档案具体配方要与当年版本相连，不能用一套固定比例覆盖几十年。

producers.name: Raúl Pérez
producers.intro: 从 Ultreia Godello 认识 Raúl Pérez 的 Bierzo 白葡萄酒：同一个 Godello，进入另一组土地与酿造选择。
producers.scope: 起步档案：本次仅核对 Ultreia Godello 的官方 2016 页面；不是完整酒庄或全酒款目录。

sections.title: 从一款酒开始认识
sections.text: Raúl Pérez 的官网将 Ultreia Godello 列为 D.O. Bierzo 白葡萄酒。2016 页面正文说明 100% Godello，来源于 Valtuille de Abajo 与 Cacabelos 之间的葡萄园，并以大木桶发酵。这里先建立能回到原文的酒款入口，其他项目逐一核对后再加入。

sections.title: 从家族酒庄到个人项目
sections.text: 官方生涯介绍将其起点放在 Valtuille de Abajo 的家族酒庄 Castro Ventosa；2003 年开始 Ultreia。个人品牌、家族酒庄与合作项目应分别识别。

sections.title: La Vizcaína 的地块
sections.text: La Vizcaína 以 Valtuille 老藤为核心；原资料点名 El Rapolao、Las Gundiñas、La Poulosa、La Vitoriana，另有白酒 La del Vivo。古老混植园中 Mencía 常与其他红、白品种共存，不能全部写作 100% Mencía。

sections.title: Ultreia 的层级

sections.title: 历史档案｜1864 与 1982 两个节点
sections.text: 原生产者长档案记 Eloy Lecanda 于 1864 年建立项目，带回 Bordeaux 品种并与当地 Tempranillo 并植；Álvarez 家族在 1982 年购入。法国品种的出现是历史线索，不等于各酒永久具有同一个混酿比例。

sections.title: 葡萄园与地块选择
sections.text: 原档案强调自有葡萄、老藤、绿色采收和逐园选择；记述的约 200 公顷、树龄和补植周期属于该档案的时间切片。Tempranillo 的灌木整形与部分法国品种棚架是原文学习要点。

sections.title: Único 与 Valbuena 的逻辑
sections.text: Único 的长期培养同时包括桶与瓶，不能写成“十年全在桶中”。Valbuena 5º 的数字与总培养节奏相关；其葡萄选择及容器历程与 Único 不同，年份配比应回到年份单。

sections.title: 酒窖演变与历史酒款
sections.text: 较早访谈描述 2010 年前后从约 40,000L 大槽转向多个约 8,000L 木槽，使精细分批成为可能；文章对“以后可能每年发布 Único”的预测不是保证。主笔记另列 Valbuena 3，已恢复为历史条目。

sections.text: 原档案记载 Isaac Muga Martínez 与 Aurora Caño 于 1932 年创立；木容器发酵、自己的制桶工艺和传统澄清方法是其技术背景。

sections.text: Prado Enea 走更长熟化的经典路径；Torre Muga 体现更集中的选果与法国橡木思路。两者不是同一酒的熟化等级，Aro 也应单独识别。

sections.title: 庄园形成
sections.text: 原档案将酒庄历史追溯到 Luciano de Murrieta 1852 年的酿酒，以及 1872 年购入 Ygay 庄园；1983 年 Cebrián-Sagarriga 家族接手是另一个历史节点。

sections.title: Ygay、La Plana 与 Capellanía

sections.title: Haro 起点与公司名称
sections.text: 原档案记 1879 年 Real de Asúa 兄弟在 Haro 创立 Compañía Vinícola del Norte de España。公司 CVNE、标签常见 Cune 与集团其他酒庄是相连但不同层次的名称。

sections.title: 不同系列的历史
sections.text: Monopole 品牌注册于 1915；Viña Real 是另一条历史产品线，后来有独立酒庄；Contino 于 1973 年发展为庄园项目。Imperial 的选择和熟化方式也不能套到所有 Cune 产品。

sections.title: 原料来源与白酒复兴
sections.text: 原资料区分帝国系列选地、购买葡萄与其他庄园，不能写成整个 CVNE 集团只用自有园。Monopole Clásico 及 Gran Reserva 恢复历史白酒做法，和年轻 Monopole 分开学习。

sections.title: Imperial、Viña Real 与 Contino 的选地

sections.title: 创立与地方品种
sections.text: Pablo Calatayud 于 1995 年创立酒庄，复兴 Mandó 与 Verdil 等本地品种。2017 文章把它放在 Clariano 以及 Terres dels Alforins 的地区合作背景下，说明质量提升与地方葡萄园的联系。

sections.title: 2006 年旧酒窖与陶罐
sections.text: 2006 年购入带有地下陶罐酒窖的旧产业；原文把其年代形容为可能很古老，但没有充分依据认定为罗马时代。酒庄认为陶罐可以在炎热产区保留果实与土地表达，避免新橡木额外增加甜感与结构。

sections.title: 酒款的层次与年份
sections.text: Cullerot 2016 是 Verdil/PX/Macabeo/Chardonnay 白混酿，陶罐 6 个月；Safrà 2015 为 85% Mandó 加 Garnacha，采收思路偏向鲜活的桃红式成熟度；Parotet 2013 则以约 75% Mandó 加 Monastrell，结构较厚。三组配方只属于原文年份，不覆盖官网后来的比例。

sections.title: 白酒与跨产区
sections.text: Lapola 属 Ribeira Sacra，2019 以 Godello 为主；Lalume 2019 是 Ribeiro 的 Treixadura 主导白酒，来自 Avia、Arnoia 与 Miño 流域。两者不可因同一生产者被合并。

sections.title: 容器与证据冲突
sections.text: 团队共有介绍写“完全不用不锈钢”，但 2019 两份具体酒款工艺同时写 inox。保留年份技术细节：木容器、蛋形容器与不锈钢可能并用，不复制绝对化口号；未采用缺少酒款年份与评分机构证据的“红白双满分”。

sections.title: 第一款 ROC
sections.text: ROC 是项目的第一款酒，来自 Valtuille 的 El Couso 与 La Rata 百年园；2022 页同时列 Mencía 与 Palomino，黏砂土与 100% 整串发酵是该年份要点。

sections.title: Quite 的版本变化
sections.text: Quite 2023 是首次跨两个冬天培养的版本：前十个月木槽、后六个月 500L 桶。以大部分去梗和较短浸渍保留轻盈感，不能沿用更早年份统一酒龄。

sections.title: Cobrana 的村庄和土壤
sections.text: Cobrana 2022 标示 Vino de Villa de Congosto，海拔约 750 米，蓝色板岩风化成红黏土。Mencía 与白品种、Alicante Bouschet、Estaladiña 共酿，体现老园混植。

sections.title: Godello 的必要补充
sections.text: Beyond Albariño 正是在讨论 Bierzo 的 Godello 时点名 Verónica Ortega，因此补入 La Llorona 才恢复原文语境。2023 官方页确认 100% 小粒 Godello、Pieros 来源与短浸皮；页面数字冲突保留在酒款说明。

sections.text: 合作进口商记 Laura Ramos、José Martínez、Roberto Santana、Alfonso Torrente 在 Alicante 的 Miguel Hernández 大学学习酿酒时相识。各地项目共同重视传统种植和低干预酿造。

sections.title: 项目分工
sections.text: Lousas 由 Alfonso Torrente 负责 Galicia；Roberto Santana 负责 Tenerife 的 Táganan／Benje；Laura Ramos 与 José Martínez 负责 Almansa 的 Albahra。地区归属应随酒款，不能把整个生产者固定为 Canary Islands。

sections.title: 共同创办与出发点
sections.text: 官方历史以 Telmo Rodríguez、Pablo Eguzkiza 两人署名：1994 年在 Navarra 的 Sada 用老藤 Garnacha 做 Alma；1996 年开始 Basa；项目始终围绕本土品种与恢复老园。

sections.title: Galicia 的恢复
sections.text: Ladeiras do Xil 从 2002 年开始恢复 Valdeorras 的废弃园，并重新理解红白品种混植。Gaba do Xil、Branco de Santa Cruz 与 As Caborcas、Falcoeira、O Diviso 分别对应不同层级与地点。

sections.title: Ribera 与 Toro
sections.text: Matallana 汇集五村老园及传统混植；Toro 项目有 Dehesa Gago、Gago、Pago La Jara。地块与种植传统的组合是主线，不能一律写成纯 Tempranillo 或相同新桶比例。

sections.title: Gredos 的地质对照
sections.text: 1999 年开始恢复 Cebreros 的 Arrebatacapas，随后用 Pegaso Pizarra 与 Granito 展示板岩和花岗岩。Arrebatacapas 另在 2015 年起单独装瓶。

sections.title: Rueda 的演变
sections.text: Basa 早期曾使用 Sauvignon Blanc 迎合市场，官方回顾描述后来返回本土品种；当前 Basa 与 El Transistor 的配方应按现行技术页，不能套用早期记忆。

sections.title: Bodega Lanzaga 与村庄酒
sections.text: Lanzaga 使用 Lanciego 的有机丛式葡萄园，海拔约 500–700m；Tempranillo、Graciano 与 Garnacha 组成村庄表达。混凝土发酵，再用大木桶与小橡木桶熟化。

sections.title: 地块层次
sections.text: 官网另列 Las Beatas、Tabuérniga、El Velado 和 La Estrada，须与 Lanzaga 村庄酒分别识别。Remelluri 是相关但独立的酒庄项目。

producers.name: Domaine Tempier
producers.intro: Bandol 的 Peyraud 家族酒庄。以 Mourvèdre 为核心，通过单一地块酒表达不同园址。
producers.scope: 2026-10-28 核对酒庄官网。首版档案；配比和工艺按未标年份的酒庄说明整理，不能替代具体年份技术表。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: Lulu Tempier 与 Lucien Peyraud 于 1940 年入驻。1943 年开始系统重植 Mourvèdre、Cinsault、Grenache；1960 年代，Jean-Marie 与 François 逐步将 La Tourtine、La Migoua 等地块分开酿造。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 官网描述约 60 公顷的多地块体系。La Tourtine 约 5.5 公顷，向南、风强；La Migoua 约 11 公顷，位于 Beausset-Vieux，地质构造复杂；Cabassaou 约 1.5 公顷，避 Mistral 风、温暖，梯田土层浅。面积为酒庄描述，并非土地权属证明。

sections.title: 酒款
sections.text: 本批收录三款地块红酒、Bandol Blanc 和 Bandol Rosé。基础红酒的旧名称与现行 Lulu & Lucien 酒标须另行对照年份。

wines.name: Cabassaou
wines.place: La Tourtine 下方避风、温暖的梯田。
wines.grape: 酒庄常规说明：Mourvèdre 92–94%，其余 Syrah、少量 Cinsault。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选，去梗破碎；本土酵母发酵约 3–4 周，foudre 熟成至少 18 个月。
wines.detail: 结构紧密、浓度高；酒庄强调其陈年潜力。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-28 核对酒庄官网。首版档案；配比和工艺按未标年份的酒庄说明整理，不能替代具体年份技术表。

en.place: Warm, sheltered terraces below La Tourtine.
en.grape: House composition: 92–94% Mourvèdre, with Syrah and a little Cinsault.
en.method: Sorted, destemmed fruit; native-yeast fermentation for 3–4 weeks, followed by at least 18 months in foudres.
en.detail: A concentrated, tightly structured red described by the estate as suitable for extended cellaring.
en.vintageScope: Estate sources checked 28 October 2026. First-edition profile; undated house specifications do not establish every vintage’s blend or production.

wines.name: La Migoua

sections.title: History
sections.text: Raymond-Étienne Amiel acquired the property in 1816. Charles Dupuy acquired it in 1907, and successive Dupuy generations developed its reputation for vins doux naturels. Olivier Decelle began a period of renewal in 1999, developing dry wines alongside fortified Maury.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: The estate chronology records Raymond-Étienne Amiel from 1816, the Charles and Jean Dupuy family era from 1907 to 1997, and Olivier Decelle’s transformation from 1999. These historical roles do not establish current shareholding percentages.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: Mas Amiel lies in the Agly valley at Maury, Roussillon. The estate page describes about 95 parcels and 100 hectares of vineyards, including old Grenache and Carignan on schist and calcareous schist. A historical 1999 account gives 155 planted hectares within a 226-hectare property; the figures refer to different dates and definitions. The estate reports organic certification in 2017 and biodynamic certification by 2020.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: The fortified portfolio includes Vintage Rouge, Vintage Réserve, Vintage Charles Dupuy, Vintage Blanc, aged oxidative blends and vintage-dated Maury. The Trésors du Temps selection includes 20, 30, 40 and 50 Ans d’Âge. Dry wines include Maury Sec and Côtes du Roussillon. Availability and individual cuvée specifications depend on the release.

wines.name: 50 Ans d'Âge
wines.place: Maury old-vine Roussillon schist terroir; individual contributing plots and base-vintage components not stated in available official 50 Ans source.
wines.grape: 100% Grenache Noir, according to the estate’s Trésors du Temps description of 50 Ans d’Âge.
wines.method: The estate’s oxidative house process includes fortification on skins, about one year outdoors in 60-litre glass demijohns, then extended maturation in old oak foudres. This describes the house method; the exact chronology for 50 Ans d’Âge is not established in the cited product page.
wines.detail:
Very mature oxidative Maury with rancio, layered dried fruit, nutty and deeply savoury complexity (style characterization drawn from official aged blend description, not blind tasting).
Vin doux naturel oxidatif, AOC Maury Rouge · multi-vintage aged blend
wines.vintageScope: A multi-vintage aged blend included in the estate’s Trésors du Temps selection alongside 20, 30 and 40 Ans d’Âge. Base vintages and a complete cuvée-specific ageing chronology are not supplied.

wines.name: Vintage Blanc
wines.place: Vintage 2025 estate page: schist slopes Mas Fredes sector, SW exposure, clay at depth; goblet vines 60–75y, average 18 hL/ha, biodynamic cultivation as described for this release.
wines.method: Vintage 2025 official: manual harvest and double sort, direct press without destemming, fermentation in thermoregulated stainless at approximately 18°C, fortification mid fermentation on juice; approximately 10 months on lees in reductive tank to conserve fresh fruit.
wines.detail:
2025 producer note (paraphrase): mineral/fresh white VDN, grapefruit, mandarin and citrus peel, fresh finish; not an independent critic tasting.
Vin doux naturel, AOC Maury Blanc · reductive white VDN (not dry wine)

sections.title: History
sections.text: The family estate lies at Casalabriva in the Taravo valley of southern Corsica. Antoine Abbatucci established a collection of traditional Corsican grape varieties; Jean-Charles developed biodynamic farming and heritage-variety research. The Collection range, celebrating historical family figures, began in 2006.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: The estate website names Jean-Charles and his daughter Faustine Abbatucci as proprietor-vignerons. Its 2026 legal notice identifies EARL Domaine Comte Abbatucci. Detailed beneficial shareholdings are not given.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: The estate describes 21 hectares of vines on decomposed granitic sands near 150 metres altitude in the Taravo valley. Its ampelographic collection conserves a range of native grapes; the estate area is not an individual cuvée’s vineyard area.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Biodynamic cultivation and conservation of Corsican grapes are central to the estate’s stated approach. The website’s reference to 18 old or native varieties concerns the conservatory, not the blend of every wine.

sections.title: Vinification
sections.text: Methods vary by range. Faustine whites and rosés largely use stainless steel; the red uses a longer maceration. Collection whites combine demi-muids and stainless steel. Parcellaires wines may use foudres, demi-muids or tanks. Wine-specific technical sheets define the relevant process.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: The portfolio includes Faustine Blanc, Rouge and Rosé; the Parcellaires wines Alte Rosso Blanc, Monte Bianco Rouge and Valle di Nero Rosé; and Collection wines Ministre Impérial Rouge, Diplomate d’Empire Blanc and Général de la Révolution Blanc. The current Ministre Impérial technical sheet specifies Vin de France. Historical Faustine Vieilles Vignes Rosé naming requires a corresponding release label. Other estate ranges include Empire Sparkling, Dolce Rosso and the Insolites Valle di Mare and Monte Mare.

wines.name: Alte Rosso
wines.place: Parcellaires single-terroir selection on decomposed granitic sands in the Taravo valley. Exact parcel boundaries and area are not given.
wines.method: Whole-berry press; cold settling 24–48h, fermentation in 12 hL Stockinger foudre; lees/oak ageing 12 months + stainless 3 months; malolactic blocked by cold/SO2 per winery profile.
wines.detail:
Producer notes smoky, toasted/peaty and white-stone-fruit aromas with citric bite and saline finish.
White · Vin de France · Parcellaires
wines.vintageScope: The estate identifies Alte Rosso as a white wine. Its wine-specific profile gives Vin de France and an undated house method; exact vintage specifications may differ.

wines.name: Diplomate d'Empire
wines.place: Estate ampelographic/heritage grape collection from granitic sands in Taravo valley; distinct parcels pressed together or separately depending on maturity.
wines.grape: Vermentino, Brustiano, Bianco Gentile, Genovese and Rossola Bianca.
wines.method: Gentle direct pressing, static settling 24–48h; alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in demi-muids; nine months on lees in wood then 6–7 months in stainless after assembly (estate house process).
wines.detail:
Estate describes floral/chamomile and yellow-fruit aromas, expansive silky white palate, retained mineral/saline freshness.
White · Collection range
wines.vintageScope: The estate portfolio supplies an undated house profile. An exact legal designation for a specific vintage is not established by the source used here.

wines.name: Faustine Rouge
wines.place: Domaine Comte Abbatucci Taravo valley near Casalabriva, granitic sandy soils; estate has 21ha total, not the cuvée's vineyard surface.
wines.grape: Estate house profile: 70% Sciaccarello (Sciaccarellu), 30% Nielluccio (Niellucciu, a name for Sangiovese). The proportions are not assigned to every vintage.
wines.method: Official house profile: destemmed, gravity reception, uncrushed fruit; approximately 1 month maceration/fermentation in concrete with daily pumping over; 6 months stainless ageing.
wines.detail:
Estate description: cherry and wild red fruit, myrtle, pepper and spice, fine supple tannins and a fresh, persistent fruit-led finish.
Red · Faustine range
wines.vintageScope: The estate’s undated wine profile describes a house method. The legal appellation for a particular vintage requires its bottle label or technical sheet.

wines.name: Ministre Impérial
wines.place: Native Corsican grape conservatory on granitic sands in the Taravo valley, near Casalabriva. The cuvée’s exact parcel area is not stated.
wines.grape: Morescola, Morescono, Aleatico, Carcajolo Nero, Montanaccia, Sciaccarellu and Niellucciu (Sangiovese), according to the estate technical sheet.
wines.method: Winery technical process: destemmed/gravity intake, spontaneous fermentation and about one month extraction in truncated wooden vats, 12 months demi-muid maturation and six further months in steel.
wines.detail:
Producer notes ripe currants/blackberries, Corsican myrtle, subtle spice, fine tannins and persistent savory mineral finish.
Red · Vin de France · Collection wine
wines.vintageScope: The cited wine-specific estate technical sheet explicitly identifies Ministre Impérial as Vin de France Rouge. Its production details are not tied to a named vintage.

wines.name: Valle di Nero
wines.place: A Taravo site on granitic sands, selected for the Parcellaires range. Exact boundaries and vineyard area are not supplied.
wines.grape: 100% Carcajolo Nero, according to the estate technical sheet.
wines.method: Direct press, fermentation in demi-muid on indigenous yeasts, c.9 months in wood then 3 months tank, as official wine fiche describes.
wines.detail:
Estate notes orange blossom, fresh citrus/clementine, peach, apricot and delicate saline/savory texture.
Rosé · Vin de France · Parcellaires
wines.vintageScope: The estate’s wine-specific profile identifies Valle di Nero as a Vin de France rosé. The cited production method is undated.

wines.name: Monte Bianco
wines.place: Slopes of granitic sand in the Taravo valley, selected for the Parcellaires range. Exact plot boundaries are not supplied.
wines.grape: 100% Sciaccarello per official winery's undated technical description.
wines.method: Destemmed and uncrushed, gravity fed; approximately 1 month skin contact with indigenous spontaneous fermentation in truncated-cone vats, 12 months demi-muid + six months tank.
wines.detail:
Estate describes cherry/strawberry and wild maquis/myrtle nose, fine soft tannins and savory/mineral finish.
Red · Vin de France · Parcellaires
wines.vintageScope: Despite its name, Monte Bianco is a red wine. The estate’s wine-specific profile identifies Vin de France and supplies an undated house method.

wines.name: Faustine Blanc
wines.place: Taravo valley estate granitic-sands parcels, southern Corsica; exact named plots and harvest area for cuvée not in source.
wines.grape: 100% Vermentino (Vermentinu / Rolle), according to the estate’s undated house profile.
wines.method: Whole-bunch or destemmed press depending on grape condition; 24–48h settling; controlled stainless fermentation; six months lees contact; optional fining and cold tartaric stabilization.
wines.detail:
Estate description: white flower, anise, freshness and evolving mineral/petrol nuances with bottle age.
Dry white · Faustine range
wines.vintageScope: The estate’s technical recipe is not tied to a particular vintage. A bottle-specific legal designation is not established in this profile.

wines.name: Faustine Rosé
wines.place: Granitic sands in the Taravo valley, Corsica. Individual cuvée parcels and area are not specified.
wines.grape: 100% Sciaccarello (Sciaccarellu), according to the estate’s undated descriptive profile.
wines.method: Whole-cluster/destemmed direct press, 24–48h static settling, controlled fermentation in stainless; bottle filtration if necessary.
wines.detail:
Estate notes pink grapefruit, floral tones and red berries, silky texture and delicate peach/apricot finish.
Dry rosé · Faustine range
wines.vintageScope: The estate’s wine profile does not specify a vintage. The legal appellation requires the corresponding release label.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Domaine Gauby is a family property centred on Calce in Roussillon, associated with terroir-focused wines and organic, biodynamic and regenerative farming. Distributor and regional accounts describe Gérard Gauby’s development of the estate and Lionel Gauby’s subsequent role in vinification.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: Gérard Gauby established and expanded the domaine; distributor accounts identify Lionel with later winemaking and estate stewardship. Family roles, company representatives and land ownership are distinct matters; detailed current shareholdings are not established here.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: Distributor and regional sources describe an approximately 85-hectare ecosystem: around 45 hectares of vines and 40 hectares of grassland, woodland and garrigue. Sites lie near 150–200 metres altitude, with limestone, marl and schist under Mediterranean influence. Some vines exceed a century in age. Areas and vine ages are source-specific.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Distributors describe organic and biodynamic cultivation with preparations made at the estate. These farming descriptions do not, by themselves, document a current certification.

sections.title: Vinification
sections.text: Whole-bunch handling, carbonic maceration and maturation vary by wine and period. The 2023 La Muntada description specifies 70% Grenache and 30% Carignan, with 14 months in foudre and concrete. That release is IGP Côtes Catalanes; older Côtes du Roussillon Villages descriptions belong to their respective vintages.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: The distributor’s 2026 list includes Les Calcinaires Blanc and Rouge, Vieilles Vignes Blanc and Rouge, La Muntada Rouge, Coume Gineste Blanc and La Jasse, under IGP Côtes Catalanes. Historical references also include La Roque. Colour and vintage distinguish wines that share a cuvée name.

wines.name: La Muntada
wines.place: Gauby family old-vine selected parcels in Calce Roussillon, limestone marls; producer sheet 2023 states 30–95-year-old vines, not a claim that every component is 95 years.
wines.grape: 2023: 70% Grenache, 30% Carignan, in the wine-specific technical information reproduced by the retailer. Older descriptions include different grapes and appellations.
wines.method: The 2023 estate-supplied description reports hand harvesting and sorting, whole-bunch maceration for up to about 15 days in concrete with native yeasts, then 14 months in foudre and concrete and ten months in bottle. Older importer descriptions of 21 months in foudre refer to other releases.
wines.detail:
2023 retailer's quoted estate description: red cherry, floral aromas, silken finely powdered tannins, concentrated yet precise fruit.
Red · IGP Côtes Catalanes · 2023
wines.vintageScope: The 2023 release is described as IGP Côtes Catalanes. A 2019 listing uses Côtes du Roussillon Villages; the older designation does not establish the classification of 2023.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Jean and Agnès Foillard took over Jean’s father’s property in 1980. Jean became associated with the Beaujolais low-intervention movement influenced by Jules Chauvet and the group often called the “Gang of Four”: Lapierre, Thévenet, Breton and Foillard. This history is documented by importer Kermit Lynch.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: Importer sources identify Jean and Agnès with the 1980 takeover. Alex Foillard also appears as an associated grower, with a distinct portfolio; current legal shareholding percentages are not documented in this profile.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: The importer describes close to 14 hectares at the time of publication, including Morgon Côte du Py, Corcelette, Les Charmes and Fleurie. Côte du Py descriptions refer to schist, granite and manganese; Corcelette is lighter and sandy. Cuvée 3.14 draws on very old Gamay, described as around a century old. Portfolio-wide vineyard totals are not individual cuvée areas.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The importer reports certified organic farming, hand sorting, restrained sulphur use and unfiltered bottling. These descriptions are tied to the importer’s publication, rather than a separately examined current certificate.

sections.title: Vinification
sections.text: For several Morgon cuvées, the importer describes traditional whole-bunch, semi-carbonic fermentation over three to four weeks and six to nine months in used Burgundy barrels. Corcelette may also use a 30-hectolitre foudre. Timing and vessels may vary by vintage.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: The Morgon selection includes Côte du Py, Corcelette, Cuvée 3.14 and Les Charmes, also encountered as Eponym’. The importer additionally lists Beaujolais-Villages and Fleurie. Cuvée 3.14 is a selected very-old-vine expression whose release is vintage-dependent.

wines.name: Les Charmes
wines.place: Les Charmes, one of the higher-altitude Morgon sites, 1.5 ha source property noted by importer, schist/granite/manganese. Distinguish from Côte du Py site and Corcelette sand.
wines.grape: Gamay. The importer describes vines around 45–50 years old for the Les Charmes / Eponym’ cuvée; the vine-age statement is source-specific.
wines.method: Importer: selected hand harvest, whole-cluster fermentation approximately 3–4 weeks, approximately 6–9 months neutral used oak barrels, no filtration.
wines.detail:
Importer description of Eponym' Les Charmes: lively floral perfume, fine bright red-fruit and acid lift, transparent tannin and mineral tension.
Red · Morgon AOC · Les Charmes / Eponym’
wines.vintageScope: Importer naming includes Les Charmes Eponym’; older releases may be labelled Eponym’ alone. The cited 2021 listing and general technical profile have different scopes.

wines.name: Corcelette
wines.place: Corcelette in Morgon, on sandy decomposed granite and sandstone. The importer’s 8.6-hectare figure covers several named Morgon wines, rather than this cuvée alone.
wines.grape: Gamay, old-vine single-sector Morgon. Imported technical record indicates about 80-year-old vines, source year not specified.
wines.method: Importer: traditional whole-bunch fermentation approximately 3–4 weeks; approximately 6–9 months in used oak barriques and a 30 hL foudre.
wines.detail:
Importer site comparison: very aromatic red fruit with floral lift, silky textural Gamay from lighter sandy soil.
Red · Morgon AOC · Corcelette lieu-dit
wines.vintageScope: Vine age and cellar details are an importer baseline, not a technical sheet for a named vintage.

wines.name: Côte du Py
wines.place: Côte du Py hill in Morgon (Villié-Morgon), schist/decomposed volcanic bedrock, granite and manganese; site-specific rather than general Gamay.
wines.grape: Gamay. The importer describes vines approximately 10–90 years old across the site; this is not a fixed vintage blend specification.
wines.method: Importer standard Côte du Py: selective hand harvest; whole-cluster fermentation approximately 3–4 weeks; approx 6–9 months in used Burgundy barrels; bottled unfiltered, minimal/late sulphur by producer practice.
wines.detail:
Importer: depth of pomegranate and dark tea, stony volcanic texture, firm yet velvety structural underpinning and ageworthiness.
Red · Morgon AOC · Côte du Py cru lieu-dit
wines.vintageScope: A separate importer page documents the 2024 release. General cellar details below describe the importer’s house baseline and may vary by vintage.

wines.name: Cuvée 3.14
wines.place: Selected very old Gamay from Côte du Py sectors described with schist, granite and manganese. The importer’s 8.6-hectare figure covers its wider Morgon roster, not Cuvée 3.14 alone.
wines.grape: Gamay; importer links 3.14 to very old vines around 100 years (source vintage not specified).
wines.method: Whole cluster fermentation 3–4 weeks; about 6–9 months in used Burgundy oak barrels, minimum two years old; bottled unfiltered with limited SO2 exposure as per importer general scheme.
wines.detail:
The importer describes a concentrated, finely textured old-vine Gamay with deep fruit and a pronounced mineral character.
Red · Morgon AOC · limited Côte du Py very-old-vine selection
wines.vintageScope: Importer technical information describes the cuvée without establishing an annual release schedule. Availability and specifications depend on the vintage.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Hervé and Claudine Bizeul established Domaine du Clos des Fées at Vingrau in Roussillon in the late 1990s. Estate and importer accounts describe a portfolio assembled from small parcels across several Roussillon terroirs.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: Hervé Bizeul is identified as founder and vigneron, with Claudine Bizeul in the estate’s historical account. A current corporate shareholding breakdown is not documented in the sources used here.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: The estate works a mosaic of limestone-clay, marl and schist sites around Vingrau, exposed to the Tramontane. A 2025 importer catalogue describes approximately 30 hectares across several terroirs and more than 100 plots. La Petite Sibérie is a particular old-vine, Grenache-dominant, wind-exposed parcel; these estate-wide figures are not its area.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: Principal names include Le Clos des Fées, Vieilles Vignes, Les Sorcières, La Petite Sibérie and De battre mon cœur s’est arrêté. Vieilles Vignes and Les Sorcières occur in both red and white forms. The 2023 Post Scriptum release has a distinct identity from standard La Petite Sibérie. Appellation, colour and technical details require the corresponding wine and vintage.

wines.name: Le Clos des Fées
wines.place: 2020 estate material: mosaic of small old-vine hillside parcels on clay-limestone in Roussillon. This is a multi-parcel blend, not a single owned vineyard site.
wines.grape: 2020: 25% Grenache Noir, 10% Mourvèdre, 50% Syrah and 15% Carignan, according to the estate shop’s technical sheet.
wines.method: The 2020 estate sheet describes manual selection at and after destemming, chilled transport and some fermentation in 500-litre demi-muids. Élevage used 100% new oak for approximately 18 months on lees. These details concern the dated release.
wines.detail:
Producer description of 2020: exceptionally concentrated dark fruit, complex spice and creamy substantial tannin, long fresh persistent finish; not an independent critic note.
Red · Le Clos des Fées · 2020
wines.vintageScope: Composition and oak treatment refer to the archived 2020 estate sheet. An exact legal appellation for this release is not independently established in this profile.

wines.name: La Petite Sibérie
wines.place: The 2024 estate sheet describes a south-facing old-vine parcel on an east–west knoll, with clay-limestone bedrock cut by iron-rich schist. Cold northwesterly wind is reported for more than 200 days per year. Exact cadastral boundaries are not supplied.
wines.grape: 2024: 96% Grenache Noir, 2% Mourvèdre and 2% Syrah. The estate also gives similar proportions for some older releases.
wines.method: 2024 source: hand picked, refrigerated transport, approximately 20 days maceration with gentle punch-down, run to new Saury barrels; lees ageing without added SO2 according to estate, occasional top-up with Mourvèdre/Syrah blend.
wines.detail:
House notes black fruit, cassis and blueberry, layered vanilla/wood aromatics, intense yet silky tannin and powerful finish with notable freshness.
Red · La Petite Sibérie · single old-vine cuvée
wines.vintageScope: This profile concerns the 2024 estate technical sheet. The winery describes 2023 Post Scriptum as a separate release, rather than a standard 2023 La Petite Sibérie. Exact bottle classification requires the corresponding vintage label.

producers.name: Domaine Marcel Lapierre
producers.intro: The family history in Villié-Morgon begins with Michel Lapierre in 1909. His son Camille developed bottling; Marcel took over in 1973 and, influenced by Jules Chauvet, began pursuing vinification without added sulphur in 1981. Marcel died in October 2010. Mathieu joined in 2004 and assumed management in 2010; his sister Camille joined in 2013. The name “M & C Lapierre” refers to the same family estate.
producers.scope: English first edition. Chinese translation and vintage-specific expansion are in progress.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The family history in Villié-Morgon begins with Michel Lapierre in 1909. His son Camille developed bottling; Marcel took over in 1973 and, influenced by Jules Chauvet, began pursuing vinification without added sulphur in 1981. Marcel died in October 2010. Mathieu joined in 2004 and assumed management in 2010; his sister Camille joined in 2013. The name “M & C Lapierre” refers to the same family estate.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: The family account includes Marcel, Mathieu, Camille, Anne and Marie. Mathieu’s management and winemaking role dates from 2010; Camille joined in 2013. Marie is associated with historical viticulture and sales responsibilities. Detailed current beneficial shareholdings are not stated.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: The estate’s 2026 website reports approximately 20 hectares of Gamay noir à jus blanc, predominantly in Morgon with some Beaujolais sites. Cuvée Camille comes from a southwest-facing Côte du Py site on shallow granitic bedrock; an older technical sheet gives one hectare. These figures have different geographical and chronological scopes.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The estate reports organic certification since 2004 and a farming approach developed from around 1981.

sections.title: Vinification
sections.text: Hand harvesting and sorting precede semi-carbonic Beaujolais maceration with indigenous yeast. Sulphur additions during vinification are limited or absent, while bottling practice varies by wine and batch. Cuvée Camille receives a longer maceration in a wooden truncated-conical vat; exact timing is vintage-dependent.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: Morgon and Cuvée Camille are part of a wider portfolio that includes Cuvée Marcel Lapierre, Raisins Gaulois, Beaujolais and Bourgogne Pinot Noir. Cuvée Camille has historical Roche du Py and Côte du Py references; it is distinct from Cuvée Marcel Lapierre.

wines.name: Domaine M & C Lapierre — Morgon
wines.place: The estate website describes approximately 18 hectares in Morgon across different terroirs within three kilometres of the Villié-Morgon winery. This is the estate’s Morgon area, rather than a vineyard dedicated solely to this cuvée. The estate reports organic certification since 2004.
wines.method: The estate describes hand harvesting, chilling and sorting, followed by semi-carbonic whole-cluster fermentation with native yeasts for approximately 9–35 days according to parcel and vintage. Maturation takes place in used barrels; bottling is unfiltered. Some batches receive a light sulphur addition before bottling, while nature or N bottlings are separately identified.
wines.detail:
Estate notes cherry, violet, raspberry and faint liquorice; light yet rich fruit, terroir expression and potential to age around a decade.
Red · Morgon AOC · Domaine Marcel Lapierre
wines.vintageScope: An undated estate house profile, with source material reviewed in October 2026. “M & C Lapierre” is a naming variant of Domaine Marcel Lapierre.

wines.name: Domaine M & C Lapierre — Cuvée Camille Roche du Py
wines.place: A southwest-facing Côte du Py parcel on shallow granitic bedrock, according to the estate. An older technical sheet uses Roche du Py and gives one hectare; the dated area does not establish a current measurement.
wines.grape: Gamay noir à jus blanc. The name honours both Marcel’s daughter Camille and his father Camille. Cuvée Camille is distinct from Cuvée Marcel Lapierre.
wines.method: Current estate: longer semi-carbonic whole-bunch maceration all in wooden truncated-conical vat compared with general Morgon; old barrique élevage. Details by vintage not generalized.
wines.detail:
Estate describes a structured, fine Gamay with concentrated red fruit and broad floral resonance; stylistic descriptions are producer-only not critic tasting.
Red · Morgon AOC · Camille (historical Roche/Côte du Py naming)
wines.vintageScope: The estate identifies Cuvée Camille; historical references also use Roche du Py. Supplier listings cover 2022–2025, but the house method below is not a vintage-specific technical specification.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Jean-Marc Burgaud founded the Villié-Morgon estate in 1989. Its 2026 website reports 17.5 hectares in Beaujolais: 12.5 in Morgon and five in Lantignié. Morgon expressions include Côte du Py, Javernières, La Roche, James, Ruyère and Chollet.

sections.title: People and ownership
sections.text: Jean-Marc Burgaud is the founder and winemaker. The sources used here do not establish a detailed current shareholding or succession structure.

sections.title: Vineyards and sites
sections.text: Côte du Py is described as a south-facing hill of blue schist rich in iron oxides, alongside the estate’s separate granite and clay sites. A dated commercial account refers to six hectares at Côte du Py; the estate’s 12.5 hectares in Morgon represent a broader area.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: An organic certification is not established by the sources used in this first edition.

sections.title: Vinification
sections.text: Estate and importer sources describe whole-cluster Gamay maceration. A Côte du Py importer profile gives seven to twelve days; an older technical sheet gives twelve to fourteen. These are source-specific descriptions, rather than a fixed protocol for every vintage.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: The estate lists Lantignié whites and reds alongside Morgon Chollet, Ruyère, La Roche, Côte du Py, Javernières and James. This first edition includes an individual Côte du Py profile.

wines.name: Côte du Py
wines.place: Côte du Py near Villié-Morgon, on high hills of iron-rich blue schist. The estate’s 17.5 hectares comprise 12.5 in Morgon and five in Lantignié; this is not the area devoted to Côte du Py. Javernières, James and Chollet are separate estate labels.
wines.grape: Gamay noir, as identified by the estate and importer.
wines.method: Regal Wine current profile lists whole-grape maceration 7–12 days, but older PDF says 12–14 days. This is source/vintage drift; keep as a range attributable to respective sources, not invariant winemaking claim.
wines.detail:
Official house style: powerful ageworthy Gamay with noble tannins and kirsch-like notes rooted in blue-stone schist, producer not independent critic note.
Red · Morgon AOC · Côte du Py
wines.vintageScope: Estate and importer descriptions provide the basis for this profile. No additional claim about changes to legal site-name eligibility is made from commercial commentary alone.

producers.name: Domaine Dureuil-Janthial
producers.village: 10 rue de la Buisserolle, 71150 Rully, France
producers.intro: Céline 与 Vincent Dureuil 自 1994 年接掌的 Rully 家族酒庄，葡萄园超过 20 ha，分布于 Côte Chalonnaise、Côte de Beaune 与 Côte de Nuits。Rully 系列涵盖村庄级和多个一级园，白、红葡萄酒均有逐款技术资料。
producers.scope: 官网系列与逐款技术表已核对。技术表保留原始日期；其面积、种植年与酿造参数不自动代表每个新年份。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: Janthial 家族的 Rully 渊源可追溯至十三世纪。Céline 与 Vincent Dureuil 于 1994 年承接家族酒庄；Vincent 获得 La Revue du Vin de France 2019 年度 Vigneron。旧文将其定位为 Rully 风土复兴代表；这属于报道评价，不是官方法定等级。

sections.title: 所有权
sections.text: Céline 与 Vincent Dureuil 于 1994 年承接家族酒庄。官网将 Janthial 家族在 Rully 的历史追溯至十三世纪。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 官网记载超过 20 ha，涵盖 Rully、Mercurey、Puligny-Montrachet 与 Nuits-Saint-Georges；其中某些微小地块仅 0.0871 ha。不同地块的老藤栽植年份均按酒款技术单保留。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 强调土壤生命力、有机导向、人工采收、产量管理和地块区分。公开技术单提到不同地块及手工分选；有机证书状态需另外确认，不能单凭报道宣称最新认证。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 2019 版白葡萄酒技术单：直接压榨、约 48 小时静置澄清、木桶酒精发酵、约 12 个月桶熟和约 6 个月不锈钢熟成；红葡萄酒双重分选、视年份去梗与否、木质截锥形发酵罐、浸渍和桶熟。文件中的新桶比例是历史技术基准而非所有年份恒定数字。

wines.detail: 南向、表层砾石的 La Fosse，排水较快，果实成熟度与结构在炎热年份特别值得研究。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现仍链接的历史技术表（2019 年版式；Cloux 文件于 2022 年上传）。种植年、面积和桶陈参数按该表记录，并非某个当前年份的保证。

en.place: Mid-slope near village; southern exposure below Rabourcé; Gravel over clay-limestone; well drained; Planting years in historical sheet: 1973; Historical parcel area: 0.227 ha
en.method: Hand-harvested and double-sorted; destemming depends on vintage. Wooden truncated-cone vats, c.1-week cold maceration, c.12 months barrel (historical sheet c.33% new oak) plus 6 months tank; malolactic fermentation.
en.detail: South-facing, freely draining gravel over clay-limestone below Rabourcé; precise ripeness management is central.
en.vintageScope: Historical estate sheet still linked in its portfolio (2019 document template; Cloux uploaded in 2022). Plantings, area and élevage are sheet-specific, not a guarantee for a current vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Cloux
wines.place: Raclot 与 Rabourcé 下方的中坡，酒庄地块朝东（所在坡地总体朝东至东南）；黏土石灰质土; 历史技术单所列栽植年：1936; 历史地块面积：0.0871 ha
wines.method: 人工采收双重分选；视年份全去梗或部分保留整串，木质截锥形发酵罐、约一周冷浸渍；历史技术单约 33% 新桶熟成 12 个月，再转不锈钢罐约 6 个月，进行苹果酸乳酸发酵。
wines.detail: 极小面积老藤红葡萄一级园，仅 0.0871 ha；官网 2022 技术单仅标 150 cl 格式，不能推断所有年份或所有市场只有镁瓶。 技术表所列规格为 150 cl。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现仍链接的历史技术表（2019 年版式；Cloux 文件于 2022 年上传）。种植年、面积和桶陈参数按该表记录，并非某个当前年份的保证。

en.place: Estate parcel faces east; the wider slope beneath Raclot and Rabourcé faces east to southeast. Clay-limestone soil; planted 1936; historical area 0.0871 ha.
en.method: Hand-harvested and double-sorted; destemming depends on vintage. Wooden truncated-cone vats, c.1-week cold maceration, c.12 months barrel (historical sheet c.33% new oak) plus 6 months tank; malolactic fermentation.
en.detail: Tiny 0.0871-ha old-vine parcel planted in 1936; 2022-format sheet lists 150cl only, not proof that all vintages/markets lack 75cl. The technical sheet lists a 150 cl format.
en.vintageScope: Historical estate sheet still linked in its portfolio (2019 document template; Cloux uploaded in 2022). Plantings, area and élevage are sheet-specific, not a guarantee for a current vintage.

en.intro: A Rully family estate run by Céline and Vincent Dureuil since 1994, with more than 20 ha across the Côte Chalonnaise, Côte de Beaune and Côte de Nuits. Its Rully portfolio spans village wines and several Premier Cru sites in both colours.
en.scope: Estate portfolio and individual technical sheets checked. Historical sheet dates remain explicit; specifications do not automatically apply to every subsequent vintage.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The Janthial family has roots in Rully dating to the 13th century. Céline and Vincent Dureuil took over in 1994. Vincent was named 2019 Vigneron of the Year by La Revue du Vin de France.

sections.title: Ownership
sections.text: Céline and Vincent Dureuil took over in 1994. The estate traces the Janthial family’s roots in Rully to the thirteenth century.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: Official estate description cites more than 20 ha across Rully, Mercurey, Puligny-Montrachet and Nuits-Saint-Georges. Parcels and planting years are preserved at the wine level.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Focus on living soils, organic-oriented farming, hand picking, crop load and parcel precision. Current certification status requires independent verification.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: 2019 baseline sheets: direct pressing and 48 h settling for whites, fermentation in barrel, roughly 12 months in wood plus 6 in stainless steel. Reds: double sorting, vintage-dependent destemming, wooden vats/cold soak, about 12 months in oak plus 6 months in tank. Oak percentages are sheet-specific, not universal vintage facts.

producers.name: Domaine de Villaine
producers.village: 2 rue de la Fontaine, 71150 Bouzeron, France
producers.intro: 位于 Bouzeron 的家族酒庄，以 Aligoté、Chardonnay 与 Pinot Noir 展现 Côte Chalonnaise 的村庄与地块差异。Rully 白葡萄酒包括 Les Saint-Jacques 和六个一级园；红葡萄酒包括 Cloux 与 Les Champs Cloux。
producers.scope: 按酒庄官网及 2021–2024 年份报告整理；Cuvée Ronde 单独保留为 2021 年霜冻背景下的混合一级园酒。

sections.title: 历史与人物
sections.text: Aubert 与 Pamela de Villaine 于 1971 年开始在 Bouzeron 经营。官网人物资料列有 Aubert、Pamela、Pierre de Benoist 与 Thierry Devaux；Pierre 的风土文章强调土壤、葡萄材料和人的长期实践。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 基地位于 Bouzeron 的山谷坡地，土壤较贫瘠、富含石灰质。Rully 系列将村庄级、六个白葡萄酒一级园和红葡萄酒地块分别呈现，不能将某一园的土壤或树龄推广至全庄。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 酒庄官网称自 1986 年获 Qualicé-France 有机认证，施肥限于植物性有机堆肥，并以修剪、选种及必要时疏果控制产量。2022 年份报告同时记述有机与生物动力实践；认证沿革与具体年份实践分别理解。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 人工采收并严格分选；按酒款采用大木桶、橡木小桶、罐或其组合，控制新桶以避免遮盖果味。白葡萄酒容器与红葡萄酒整串比例均按酒款、年份记录。

sections.title: Rully 系列
sections.text: Les Saint-Jacques 是村庄级酒，不能与 Clos Saint-Jacques 一级园混同。2021 Cuvée Ronde 将六个白葡萄酒一级园混合，属于严重春霜后的特殊发行，并非第七个单一一级园。

wines.name: Rully Blanc Les Saint-Jacques
wines.place: 朝东坡脚、Clos Saint-Jacques 一级园下方的村庄级地块；1990 年栽植，深层粉砂质土。
wines.method: 2024：主要于大木桶及三年旧桶中酿造、带酒泥熟成；酒庄以约每株四串控制果实与叶幕平衡。
wines.detail: 酒庄对 2024 的描述强调清新、晶莹和脆爽果味，建议年轻时饮用。官网通用服务建议约 12–14°C，可配鱼、白肉或温和山羊奶酪。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2024。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Village parcel below Clos Saint-Jacques on an east-facing slope; planted 1990, with deep silty soil.
en.method: 2024: mainly foudre and three-year-old barrels, with lees ageing; the estate targets roughly four bunches per vine.
en.detail: The estate describes a fresh, crisp 2024 for youthful drinking. General estate service guidance is 12–14°C with fish, white meat or mild goat cheese.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2024. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Margotés
wines.place: Rully 最南端、邻近 Grésigny；石灰岩与略含泥灰质的底土，较凉爽多风。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述白花、桃、榅桲与鲜杏仁，口感兼具丰富度和白垩感。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Southern end of Rully beside Grésigny; limestone and slightly marly subsoil, with a cool, windy setting.
en.method: 2023: vinification and ageing in oak foudre.
en.detail: Estate notes describe floral, peach, quince and fresh-almond aromas with richness and chalky tension.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Grésigny
wines.place: Margotés 北侧同一石灰岩带；2023 资料将 Chardonnay 葡萄藤描述为约 80 年树龄。
wines.method: 官网年份页未提供该款的精确容器、新桶比例或熟成月数；不套用邻近地块的参数。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述桃、杏与核果感，口感饱满而细致，并指出超过十年的陈年潜力。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: North of Margotés on the same limestone vein; the 2023 account describes Chardonnay vines around 80 years old.
en.method: The vintage page does not specify vessels, new-oak percentage or ageing months for this cuvée.
en.detail: The estate describes peach and apricot, a full yet fine palate and potential beyond ten years.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Montpalais
wines.place: 石灰质地块；2023 酒庄资料称园内约 12% 为 Chardonnay Muscaté。
wines.grape: Chardonnay；酒庄称其中约 12% 为 Chardonnay Muscaté（2023）。
wines.method: 年份页未刊载该款桶型、熟成时长或新桶比例。Chardonnay Muscaté 属于 Chardonnay 的芳香型材料，不能改记为 Muscat 混酿。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述荔枝、奇异果、梨与辛香，成熟果实和酸度并存；建议年轻饮用并略作提前开瓶。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Limestone site; the 2023 estate account identifies approximately 12% Chardonnay Muscaté among the vines.
en.grape: Chardonnay, including approximately 12% Chardonnay Muscaté according to the 2023 estate account.
en.method: The page gives no vessel, ageing duration or new-oak percentage. Chardonnay Muscaté is aromatic Chardonnay material, not a declared Muscat blend.
en.detail: Estate notes combine lychee, kiwi, pear and spice with fresh acidity; youthful drinking and brief aeration are suggested.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Cloux
wines.place: 朝东葡萄园，黏土石灰质土。
wines.method: 2023：在橡木桶与 demi-muid 中熟成。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述较丰富但不过分丰腴，带鲜杏仁、咸鲜张力与清爽苦味收尾。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: East-facing vineyard on clay-limestone soils.
en.method: 2023: matured in barrels and demi-muids.
en.detail: The estate describes richness without opulence, almond notes, saline tension and a refreshing bitter finish.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Raclot
wines.place: 石灰质地块；2023 资料将其描述为较年轻葡萄藤。
wines.method: 2023：使用橡木桶与 demi-muid；酒庄指出发表品评时木质感仍在整合。
wines.detail: 花果香明显，酒庄强调酸度、成熟果实与咸鲜感的平衡。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Limestone site described as young vines in the 2023 account.
en.method: 2023: barrels and demi-muids; oak was still integrating when the estate note was written.
en.detail: Estate notes emphasize floral fruit, mineral tension and balance between acidity, ripe fruit and salinity.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Rabourcé
wines.place: 含白色黏土，日照充足，是酒庄描述中 Rully 较为向阳的地块。
wines.method: 2023：以大型木质容器酿造，新桶占比低于 8%。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述芳香丰厚、白垩感与轻微烘烤气息，余味有密度并具陈年潜力。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: White-clay soils and a particularly sunny Rully setting in the estate’s account.
en.method: 2023: large wooden vessels, with less than 8% new barrels.
en.detail: Estate notes describe aromatic richness, chalk, light toast and a dense finish with ageing potential.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Cloux
wines.place: Cloux 一级园的 Pinot Noir 红葡萄酒，与同名 Chardonnay 白葡萄酒分别建档。
wines.method: 2021：酒庄记述 80% 整串；2023 页面未给出整串比例，因此不将 2021 的比例用于 2023。
wines.detail: 2023 酒庄描述果味纯净、汁感圆润、兼具清新与力量；陈年可发展辛香。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Pinot Noir from Cloux Premier Cru, separate from the Chardonnay bottling of the same climat.
en.method: 2021: 80% whole bunch according to the estate report. The 2023 page gives no proportion, so the 2021 figure is not transferred.
en.detail: The 2023 estate note emphasizes pure fruit, roundness, freshness and restrained power, developing spice with age.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Champs Cloux
wines.place: Les Champs Cloux 一级园，Pinot Noir；与 Cloux 分别列名。
wines.method: 2023：20% 整串酿造。该比例来自 2023 年份报告。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述果味主导、带近似碘的气息、清新且单宁抛光；建议在发表报告时至其后三年内饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2023。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Pinot Noir from Les Champs Cloux Premier Cru; distinct from Cloux.
en.method: 2023: vinified with 20% whole bunches, as stated in that vintage report.
en.detail: Estate notes describe fruit-led freshness, an iodine-like nuance and polished tannins, with a suggested window of publication to three years later.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2023. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Cuvée Ronde
wines.place: 2021 春霜后将 Margotés、Grésigny、Montpalais、Cloux、Raclot 与 Rabourcé 六个白葡萄酒一级园混合。
wines.method: 酒庄报告记述相关一级园预估产量损失 65–70%；决定混酿。报告未提供统一新桶或熟成时长。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述鲜明酸度与持续感，开瓶可能略有还原。此款与将 Les Saint-Jacques、Les Clous Aimé 混合的另一款 Cuvée Ronde 不同。
wines.vintageScope: 主要年份：2021。其他年份的技术数据已另行注明；品评与饮用窗口为酒庄当时的描述。

en.place: Following the 2021 frost, six white Premier Cru sites were blended: Margotés, Grésigny, Montpalais, Cloux, Raclot and Rabourcé.
en.method: The estate reports an estimated 65–70% volume loss in these sites and the decision to blend; no common oak percentage or duration is supplied.
en.detail: The estate describes energy, persistence and slight opening reduction. This differs from the separate Cuvée Ronde combining Les Saint-Jacques and Les Clous Aimé.
en.vintageScope: Primary vintage: 2021. Other vintage specifications are explicitly dated. Tasting and drinking-window notes are the estate’s contemporary assessment.

en.intro: A family estate based in Bouzeron, working with Aligoté, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir across the Côte Chalonnaise. Its Rully whites include Les Saint-Jacques and six Premier Cru sites; the red portfolio includes Cloux and Les Champs Cloux.
en.scope: Based on the estate website and 2021–2024 vintage reports. Cuvée Ronde is retained separately as the frost-driven 2021 Premier Cru blend.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: Aubert and Pamela de Villaine began their Bouzeron project in 1971. The estate’s people page features Aubert, Pamela, Pierre de Benoist and Thierry Devaux; Pierre’s essay stresses soil, vine material and the grower’s accumulated practice.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The Bouzeron base lies on slopes with nutrient-poor, limestone-rich soils. Rully village, six white Premier Cru sites and individual red parcels are treated separately; soil or vine-age details belong to the named parcel.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The estate reports organic certification by Qualicé-France from 1986, vegetal compost and yield control through vine selection, pruning and occasional thinning. Its 2022 report also describes biodynamic practices; certification history and vintage practices are distinct statements.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Hand harvest and strict sorting precede vinification. Tuns, barrels and tanks are used selectively, with restrained new oak. White-wine vessels and red whole-bunch proportions are recorded by cuvée and vintage.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: Les Saint-Jacques is village-level and distinct from the Premier Cru Clos Saint-Jacques. Cuvée Ronde 2021 combines six white Premier Cru sites following severe spring frost; it is not a seventh single-climat bottling.

producers.name: Domaine P. et M. Jacqueson
producers.intro: 1946年 Henri Jacqueson 在 Rully 建庄。Paul 于1971年加入；Marie 于2006年、Pierre 于2015年接棒。酒庄以 Rully 的红白单地块酒为核心。
producers.scope: 已核对酒庄现行目录与可读取技术单；无年份资料按酒款级记录，文件日期与葡萄酒年份分开。

sections.title: 历史与人物
sections.text: 1946年 Henri Jacqueson 在 Rully 建庄。Paul 于1971年加入；Marie 于2006年、Pierre 于2015年接棒。酒庄以 Rully 的红白单地块酒为核心。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 约18 ha，分布 Rully、Mercurey、Bouzeron。面积与栽植年在酒款档案中逐项列明。

sections.title: 栽培与采收
sections.text: 人工采收与分选；成熟度和健康状况决定采收及压榨处理。红葡萄用小箱运输。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 橡木桶熟成，白酒轻过滤；红酒逐桶蛋清澄清后不经过滤装瓶。新桶比例与时间以各酒技术单为准。

sections.title: Rully 酒款
sections.text: 官网列12款：7款白酒、5款红酒；另保留进口商通称 Rully Rouge。新增的无单一地块一级园白酒来自外购葡萄汁。

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: La Barre、Fromanges、La Crée 三地块调配；东向，褐色钙质土及黏土坡积物。
wines.method: 人工采收、分选、直接压榨及重力澄清，桶发酵；全桶熟成12个月，15–20%新桶，轻过滤。
wines.detail: 官方新技术单列三地块；此前进口商的两地块描述属于较早资料。
wines.vintageScope: 官网现行链接的非年份技术单；文件路径日期为2024-03，不是酒款年份。

en.place: Blend of La Barre, Fromanges and La Crée; east-facing brown calcareous soils and clay colluvium.
en.method: Hand-picked, sorted, direct-pressed and gravity-settled; barrel fermentation;12 months entirely in oak,15–20% new barrels; light filtration.
en.detail: The current sheet identifies three parcels; the older importer account named only two.
en.vintageScope: Non-vintage estate sheet; 2024-03 is its file-path date, not a wine vintage.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: 进口商列出的 Rully 村庄级 Pinot Noir；未注明单一地块。
wines.method: 酒庄红酒共通工艺为橡木桶熟成、逐桶蛋清澄清及不经过滤装瓶；本条没有可对应的独立技术单。
wines.detail: 保留为进口商所列的独立名称。当前酒庄目录单列 La Barre、Les Chaponnières 及一级园红酒，没有单列此通称；尚无证据将它与某一单地块酒合并。
wines.vintageScope: 进口商目录身份；当前具体发行年份及与单地块标签的关系未确定。

en.intro: Founded at Rully by Henri Jacqueson in 1946. Paul joined in 1971; Marie took over in 2006 and Pierre joined in 2015. Site-specific red and white Rully wines anchor the domaine.
en.scope: Current estate portfolio and accessible technical sheets reviewed. Non-vintage specifications remain wine-level; document dates are separate from vintages.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: Founded at Rully by Henri Jacqueson in 1946. Paul joined in 1971; Marie took over in 2006 and Pierre joined in 2015. Site-specific red and white Rully wines anchor the domaine.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: About 18 ha across Rully, Mercurey and Bouzeron. Individual holdings and planting dates appear in the wine profiles.

sections.title: Viticulture & harvest
sections.text: Hand harvest and sorting; maturity and fruit health guide picking and pressing. Red grapes travel in small crates.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Oak maturation; whites are lightly filtered, reds egg-white fined per barrel and bottled unfiltered. New-oak shares and duration are wine-specific.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: Official portfolio:12 Rully labels,7 white and 5 red. A generic importer-listed Rully Rouge is retained separately. The unnamed Premier Cru Blanc uses purchased must.

gaps: Unpublished vintage changes are not inferred.

producers.name: Domaine Ninot
producers.intro: Ninot 家族在 Rully 的葡萄种植与制桶历史可追溯至十四世纪。Erell 于2003年返乡，具制桶训练的 Flavien 于2012年加入；兄妹以独立地块酒呈现 Rully。
producers.scope: 已核对酒庄现行目录与可读取技术单；无年份资料按酒款级记录，文件日期与葡萄酒年份分开。

sections.title: 历史与人物
sections.text: Ninot 家族在 Rully 的葡萄种植与制桶历史可追溯至十四世纪。Erell 于2003年返乡，具制桶训练的 Flavien 于2012年加入；兄妹以独立地块酒呈现 Rully。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: Rully 的 La Barre、Chaponnière、Le Meix Guillaume 及一级园 Grésigny、Marissou，另有 Mercurey 地块；La Barre 两色分别有独立技术单。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 2020年获有机认证。技术单记载单 Guyot 修剪、抹芽、耕作；采收方式依地块而异，并非所有白酒均人工采收。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 白酒原生酵母桶发酵，红酒技术单列完全去梗和冷浸。Grésigny 桶熟15个月、Marissou18个月；其余本组酒12个月。

sections.title: Rully 酒款
sections.text: 已核对官网7款 Rully：3白、4红。Le Meix Guillaume 从2021年开始独立装瓶，之前用于调配或出售葡萄／酒给酒商。

en.intro: The Ninot family’s Rully winegrowing and coopering history reaches the 14 th century. Erell returned in 2003; cooper-trained Flavien joined in 2012. The siblings focus on separate vineyard identities.
en.scope: Current estate portfolio and accessible technical sheets reviewed. Non-vintage specifications remain wine-level; document dates are separate from vintages.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: The Ninot family’s Rully winegrowing and coopering history reaches the 14 th century. Erell returned in 2003; cooper-trained Flavien joined in 2012. The siblings focus on separate vineyard identities.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: Rully holdings include La Barre, Chaponnière, Le Meix Guillaume and Premier Crus Grésigny and Marissou, alongside Mercurey vineyards. La Barre’s two colours have separate specifications.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Certified organic in 2020. Sheets describe Guyot pruning, debudding and cultivation; harvesting varies by site, so hand-picking is not assumed for every white.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Whites ferment with native yeasts in oak; red sheets specify destemming and cold soaking. Grésigny receives 15 months and Marissou 18; the other Rully sheets specify 12.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: All seven estate-listed Rully wines are represented:3 white and 4 red. Le Meix Guillaume has its own label from 2021; previously its production was blended or sold to merchants.

gaps: Unpublished vintage changes are not inferred.

producers.name: Domaine Jaeger-Defaix
producers.intro: Hélène Jaeger-Defaix 延续 Niepce 家族在 Rully 的葡萄种植传统，于 2000 年代初接手姑婆 Henriette Niepce 经营的家族庄园。2024 酒庄技术单记载经营 6.5 ha，现行目录为 5 款白葡萄酒、3 款红葡萄酒。
producers.scope: 已核对全部 8 款 Rully 酒款与 2024 酒庄技术单；历史及年份数据各按所注范围阅读。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: Hélène Jaeger-Defaix 于 2002 年接过来自姑婆 Henriette Niepce 的 Rully Montpalais 白一级园；2003 年继续接手 Préaux 红地块，2005 年开始整体管理约 4.5 ha 家族葡萄园。Niepce 家族自十六世纪种葡萄，Henri Niepce 参与推动 1930 年代 Rully 法定产区地位。

sections.title: 所有权
sections.text: Jaeger-Defaix / Niepce 家族独立庄园，官网关联 Bernard Defaix 家族酒庄，但应保留不同 Producer 身份。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 2024 酒庄技术单列总面积 6.5 ha。核心一级园包括 Montpalais、Cloux、Rabourcé、Préaux，以及 Chapitre 内的 Clos du Chapitre monopole；另有村庄级红、白葡萄酒及 Sans Soufre 白葡萄酒。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 2024 酒庄技术单说明自 2007 年采用有机栽培，并注明 Ecocert 认证；认证表述以该资料为据。红葡萄采用疏芽控产，采收时在田间及酒窖严格分选。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 2024 常规白葡萄酒采用旧桶发酵及 12 个月桶熟，随后 6 个月罐熟；Sans Soufre 则在不锈钢罐细酒泥熟成 8 个月。红葡萄酒去梗发酵，Préaux 与村庄红采用旧桶，Clos du Chapitre 含 10% 新桶。

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: Bas de Vauvry 村庄级地块，黏土—石灰岩土壤；不可与 Premier Cru Vauvry 混同。
wines.method: 2024：原生酵母酒精发酵及自然完成的全量苹果酸—乳酸发酵；全部在旧橡木桶发酵、熟成 12 个月，期间少量搅桶，再调配并在不锈钢罐熟成 6 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述以花香、果香、杏仁及轻微矿物感为主。2024：13.5% vol，产量 30 hl/ha；建议约 12°C，陈年参考 4–6 年。
wines.vintageScope: 地块和酒标按酒庄现行页面；技术参数及服务建议明确采用 2024 技术单，不外推至其他年份。品鉴为生产者描述。

en.detail: Estate profile: floral and fruit notes, almond and a mineral accent. 2024: 13.5% ABV; 30 hl/ha; serve around 12°C; suggested cellaring 4–6 years.

en.intro: Hélène Jaeger-Defaix continued the Niepce family’s Rully tradition, succeeding great-aunt Henriette Niepce in the early 2000s. The 2024 estate sheets report 6.5 hectares; the current Rully catalogue comprises five whites and three reds.
en.scope: All eight Rully cuvées checked against estate pages and 2024 technical sheets; historical and vintage data retain their stated scope.

sections.title: History
sections.text: In 2002 Hélène Jaeger-Defaix received Montpalais from great-aunt Henriette Niepce; she took on Préaux in 2003 and managed the c.4.5-ha family estate from 2005. The Niepce family has centuries of local vineyard history.

sections.title: Ownership
sections.text: Family estate connected to the Defaix family; a distinct estate from Domaine Bernard Defaix.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The 2024 estate sheets state 6.5 hectares. The range spans Montpalais, Cloux, Rabourcé, Préaux and the Clos du Chapitre monopole, alongside village red, white and Sans Soufre white.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The 2024 estate sheets describe organic farming since 2007 and Ecocert certification. Red-wine yields are controlled by disbudding, with sorting in vineyard and cellar.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: In 2024, standard whites used old oak for 12 months followed by six months in tank; Sans Soufre spent eight months on fine lees in stainless steel. Reds were destemmed; only Clos du Chapitre’s sheet specifies 10% new oak.

gaps: Future vintage sheets and licensed imagery are maintained as releases become available.

producers.name: Domaine Michel Briday
producers.intro: Michel 与 Lucette Briday 于 1976 年创建酒庄。Stéphane 在 1988 年加入，Sandrine 于 2000 年加入；酒庄网站记载经营约 15 ha，跨 Rully、Mercurey 与 Bouzeron，重点表现地块差异。
producers.scope: 全部 8 款 Rully 酒款已与酒庄页面对应，技术资料按未标年份基线呈现。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: 1976 年由 Michel 与 Lucette 创办，起初租种约 6 ha，并自第一年份开始酒庄装瓶。Stéphane 于 1988 年加入父母的事业，Sandrine 于 2000 年加入。

sections.title: 人物与经营
sections.text: Stéphane 与 Sandrine 延续家族经营。酒庄官网记载总面积约 15 ha，主要在 Rully，并延伸至 Mercurey 与 Bouzeron。

sections.title: 葡萄园与酒款
sections.text: Rully 白葡萄酒包括村庄调配、Clos de Remenot monopole、Grésigny、La Pucelle 与 Les Cloux；红葡萄酒包括 Les 4 Vignes、Champs Cloux 与 Les Pierres。Clos de Remenot 为村庄级，不能因 monopole 而归为一级园。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 1996 年起停用除草剂并恢复全园土壤耕作；2014 年起遵循 Terra Vitis 体系。依地块观察决定必要处理，人工采收；Pinot Noir 用 20 kg 小箱运输并分选。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 原生酵母发酵，橡木使用按酒款区分。白葡萄压榨后在罐或 300/400 L 桶发酵；红葡萄采取发酵前浸渍及分酒款整串策略。具体工艺见各酒档案，不以一套比例概括全庄。

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: Chaponnières、Saint Jacques、La Crée、La Bergerie 四地块调配。La Crée 较多石质，La Bergerie 为深黏土；酒庄页面列 4.3 ha、平均树龄 40 年。
wines.method: 人工采收后立即轻柔压榨，罐与桶中原生酵母发酵；仅占调配 25% 的 La Crée 部分桶熟，其余罐熟。
wines.detail: 生产者描述为梨、柠檬、香料及少量干果，果味清晰、口感易亲近。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: Four parcels: Chaponnières, Saint Jacques, stony La Crée and deep-clay La Bergerie. The undated estate page reports 4.3 ha and average vine age 40 years.
en.method: Hand-picked and pressed promptly; native-yeast fermentation in tank and barrel. Only the La Crée portion, 25% of the blend, is barrel-aged; the remainder stays in vats.
en.detail: Producer description: pear, lemon, spice and a dried-fruit accent, with accessible, fruit-led texture.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Rouge Les 4 Vignes
wines.place: 四地块调配，包括较晚熟的坡顶石质地块及较早熟的坡脚黏土地块。酒庄页面列 4.07 ha、平均树龄 50 年；现行酒标为 Les 4 Vignes。
wines.method: 小箱人工采收、酒窖分选、去梗；按年份进行 3–8 日发酵前浸渍，原生酵母发酵，整体酿造期 20–25 日；随后橡木桶熟成，酒庄未标年份页面列 25% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述为樱桃、覆盆子、红醋栗及细致而集中的单宁，建议 4–10 年饮用参考。此为酒款级描述，不是某一年份的评分或保证。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: Four parcels combine later-ripening stony upper slopes with earlier-ripening clay lower slopes. Estate baseline: 4.07 ha; average vine age 50 years. Current cuvée name: Les 4 Vignes.
en.method: Hand-picked in small crates, sorted and destemmed; 3–8 days’ pre-fermentation maceration depending on vintage, native yeasts, 20–25 days total vinification; oak élevage with 25% new barrels in the estate’s undated description.
en.detail: Producer description: cherry, raspberry, redcurrant and concentrated yet fine tannins; suggested drinking at 4–10 years. This is cuvée-level guidance, not a vintage guarantee.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Grésigny
wines.place: Rully 南部冷凉、多风地块，石灰岩占主导，表土约 15 cm；酒庄页面列 1.10 ha、平均树龄超过 60 年，成熟较晚。
wines.method: 人工采收、立即轻柔压榨；300 L 与 400 L 桶内原生酵母发酵，全部桶熟，酒庄页面列 15% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者强调紧致、长度、柠檬和矿物风格，并提到槐花、燧石；适合给予开瓶或瓶中发展时间。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: Cool, windy southern-Rully site with limestone and approximately 15 cm topsoil. Estate baseline: 1.10 ha; vines averaging over 60 years; late ripening.
en.method: Hand harvest and immediate gentle pressing; native-yeast fermentation in 300/400 L barrels; entirely barrel-aged, with 15% new oak in the estate baseline.
en.detail: Producer description: taut, persistent and lemony, with acacia and flint associations; benefits from time to open and develop.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Pucelle
wines.place: Rully 中部正东向地块，浅黏土；酒庄页面列 0.50 ha、平均树龄 45 年。
wines.method: 人工采收、立即轻柔压榨；300 L 与 400 L 桶内原生酵母发酵。酒庄此页未公布新桶比例或熟成时长。
wines.detail: 生产者描述以柑橘、槐花、轻微烘烤及细致长余味为主；酒庄给出的陈年参考为 5–7 年。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: Due-east-facing central-Rully parcel on shallow clay. Estate baseline: 0.50 ha; average vine age 45 years.
en.method: Hand harvest and immediate gentle pressing; native-yeast fermentation in 300/400 L barrels. This wine’s estate page does not specify a new-oak percentage or élevage duration.
en.detail: Producer description: citrus, acacia and discreet toast, favouring subtlety and length; estate cellaring guidance is 5–7 years.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Les Cloux
wines.place: 村庄北侧正东向坡脚地块，土壤深，成熟较早；酒庄页面列 0.41 ha、平均树龄 45 年。
wines.method: 人工采收、立即轻柔压榨；300 L 与 400 L 桶内原生酵母发酵，全部桶熟，酒庄页面列 10% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述为梨、桃与柔顺丰润的质地，建议采收后约 3–5 年饮用参考。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: East-facing parcel north of the village, on deep lower-slope soils and relatively early ripening. Estate baseline: 0.41 ha; average vine age 45 years.
en.method: Hand harvest and immediate gentle pressing; native-yeast fermentation in 300/400 L barrels; entirely barrel-aged with 10% new oak in the estate baseline.
en.detail: Producer description: pear, peach and supple, generous texture; estate guidance suggests approaching the wine at about 3–5 years after harvest.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Clos de Remenot Monopole
wines.place: 正南向坡顶 monopole，表土不超过约 10 cm，接近石灰岩基岩，属酒庄较早采收地块。页面列 0.54 ha、平均树龄 45 年；属 Village，不是 Premier Cru。
wines.method: 人工采收、立即轻柔压榨；300 L 与 400 L 桶内原生酵母发酵，全部桶熟，酒庄页面列 10% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者强调成熟果香、浓度、丰满感与清新的结构并存；monopole 身份不改变其村庄级分级。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: South-facing upper-slope monopole with no more than about 10 cm soil above limestone, harvested early. Estate baseline: 0.54 ha; average vine age 45 years. Village, not Premier Cru.
en.method: Hand harvest and immediate gentle pressing; native-yeast fermentation in 300/400 L barrels; entirely barrel-aged with 10% new oak in the estate baseline.
en.detail: Producer description: ripe fruit and concentration, combining richness with a fresh structural line; monopole ownership does not change its Village classification.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Champs Cloux
wines.place: Rully 城堡下方东向坡，深黏土且排水良好；酒庄页面列 0.62 ha、平均树龄 50 年。
wines.method: 小箱人工采收、酒窖分选、去梗；按年份进行 3–8 日发酵前浸渍，原生酵母发酵，整体酿造期 20–25 日；橡木桶熟成，酒庄页面列 25% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述为花香、蓝莓、少量木香与香料，质地饱满，单宁细致。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: East-facing slope below Rully château, with deep but well-drained clay. Estate baseline: 0.62 ha; average vine age 50 years.
en.method: Hand-picked in small crates, sorted and destemmed; 3–8 days’ pre-fermentation maceration according to vintage, native-yeast fermentation over 20–25 days total, then oak élevage with 25% new barrels.
en.detail: Producer description: flowers, blueberry, discreet oak and spice, with plump texture and fine tannins.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Pierres
wines.place: La Pucelle 附近正东向地块，以石灰质砾石为主、黏土较少。酒庄为该小 climat 两位业主之一，页面列 0.18 ha、平均树龄 25 年。
wines.method: 小箱人工采收并分选；以去梗为主，依年份可保留约 20% 整串。发酵前浸渍 3–8 日，原生酵母发酵，整体酿造期 20–25 日；酒庄页面列 25% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述为成熟红莓、玫瑰、浓度与较扎实的单宁结构；给出的陈年参考为 5–10 年。
wines.vintageScope: 2026-10-29 核对酒庄未标年份酒款页面。面积、平均树龄、新桶比例和饮用期均为该页基线；不自动递增树龄或外推为每年份固定工艺。

en.place: Due-east-facing calcareous gravel near La Pucelle, with relatively little clay. The estate is one of two owners; baseline 0.18 ha and average vine age 25 years.
en.method: Hand-picked and sorted; predominantly destemmed, with around 20% whole clusters retained in some years. Pre-fermentation maceration 3–8 days, native-yeast fermentation, 20–25 days total vinification; 25% new oak in the estate baseline.
en.detail: Producer description: ripe red berries, rose, concentration and firm tannic structure; estate cellaring guidance is 5–10 years.
en.vintageScope: Estate’s undated wine page checked 29 October 2026. Area, average vine age, oak share and drinking guidance are the published baseline, not automatically age-adjusted or universal vintage specifications.
