en.intro: Michel and Lucette Briday founded the estate in 1976; Stéphane joined in 1988 and Sandrine in 2000. The estate reports around 15 hectares across Rully, Mercurey and Bouzeron, with a parcel-specific approach.
en.scope: All eight Rully cuvées matched to estate pages; technical details are presented as undated estate baselines.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Founded in 1976 by Michel and Lucette, initially with about six rented hectares and estate bottling from the outset. Stéphane joined in 1988; Sandrine followed in 2000.

sections.title: People and estate
sections.text: Stéphane and Sandrine continue the family estate. Its website reports approximately 15 hectares, centred on Rully with holdings in Mercurey and Bouzeron.

sections.title: Vineyards and portfolio
sections.text: Rully whites comprise the village blend, Clos de Remenot monopole, Grésigny, La Pucelle and Les Cloux; reds are Les 4 Vignes, Champs Cloux and Les Pierres. Clos de Remenot remains Village-level.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Herbicides were abandoned in 1996 in favour of soil cultivation; the estate follows Terra Vitis since 2014. Treatments depend on observation. Grapes are hand-picked, with Pinot Noir carried in 20 kg crates and sorted.

sections.title: Vinification and élevage
sections.text: Native yeasts and cuvée-specific oak regimes. Whites ferment in tank or 300/400 L barrels; reds use pre-fermentation maceration and label-dependent whole-cluster handling. Individual wine profiles specify the differences.

gaps: Future vintage sheets and licensed imagery are maintained as releases become available.

producers.name: Domaine Belleville
producers.intro: 以 Rully 为核心的地块型酒庄，官网列11款 Rully，涵盖五个白一级园及 Chapitre 红一级园；逐款区分土壤、藤龄、栽培与用桶。
producers.scope: Rully现行官网目录11款已逐款核对；采用酒款级技术资料，未将未标年份参数冒充某一年份。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: Belleville 家族于二十世纪初在 Rully 建立酒庄，随后扩展至 Mercurey 及 Côte d’Or；2023年开始经营 Monthélie 地块。

sections.title: 人物与所有权
sections.text: 官网记载酒庄于2002和2008年经历瑞士家族所有权阶段，2017年由一对美国夫妇及酒庄总监 Jean-Luc Vitoux 收购。官网没有给出该夫妇姓名或股权比例。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 官网列18 ha自有及经营葡萄园，并自2023年增管 Monthélie 4.5 ha。Rully 占10.5 ha，其中 Chardonnay 8.25 ha、Pinot Noir 2.25 ha；五款白一级园和一款红一级园合计超过4 ha。面积按酒庄网页口径，不等于2026年地籍审计。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 以地块单独管理；2017年开始转向有机耕作。官网称原18 ha自2021年份获有机认证；2023年新增 Monthélie 地块的网页状态为转换期。抹芽、修剪、覆盖作物及耕作强度按各地块调整。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 酒庄以单一地块分别酿造、熟成，强调少量硫及节制用桶。Rully技术页列12或16个月熟成，新桶比例依酒款为15%至35%；各酒款页保留自己的数值。

sections.title: Rully 酒款
sections.text: 现行官网列11款 Rully：8白、3红。白一级园为 Chapitre、La Fosse、Les Cloux、La Pucelle、Rabourcé；红一级园为 Chapitre。五款 Village 为白 Les Saint-Jacques、La Crée、La Perche，红 Chaponnière、Les Villeranges。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Chapitre
wines.place: 中坡黏土—石灰岩地块；网页所列平均藤龄约45年。酒庄加强抹芽，以控制芽数并追求更细致的表达。Chapitre 的名称与 Chalon 的 Saint-Vincent 主教座堂教士团有关。
wines.method: 酒庄未标年份技术资料：熟成12个月，新橡木桶占25%。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述以成熟白色水果、轻微烤面包及圆润质感为主，收结带咸鲜感。这是 Chardonnay 白酒；同庄 Chapitre 红酒另有独立档案。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术页，2026-10-29核对；藤龄为网页所述平均值，熟成与新桶比例不作为各年份固定保证。

en.place: Mid-slope clay-limestone parcel; the estate page gives an average vine age of about 45 years. More extensive debudding is used to refine the crop. The name recalls the chapter of Saint-Vincent cathedral in Chalon.
en.method: The undated estate profile lists 12 months of élevage and 25% new oak.
en.detail: The estate describes ripe white fruit, light toast, a rounded palate and a saline finish. This is the Chardonnay bottling; Chapitre Pinot Noir is a separate wine.
en.vintageScope: Undated producer specification checked 29 October 2026. Vine ages are the page’s stated averages; élevage and new-oak percentages are not guarantees for every vintage.

wines.imageVintageScope: Official product-page illustration; displayed bottle vintage is not guaranteed to match a purchased bottle.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Fosse
wines.place: 中坡黏土—石灰岩地块，天然凹地有泉水，为 Thalie 河源头。网页列约30年藤龄；采用较长修剪并严格抹芽管理长势。
wines.method: 酒庄未标年份技术资料：熟成12个月，新橡木桶占25%。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述为新鲜水果与矿物调性，入口清晰，酸度与圆润质感平衡，余味持久。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术页，2026-10-29核对；藤龄为网页所述平均值，熟成与新桶比例不作为各年份固定保证。

en.place: Mid-slope clay-limestone in a natural hollow with a spring at the source of the Thalie. The estate lists approximately 30-year-old vines, longer pruning and rigorous debudding to manage vigour.
en.method: The undated estate profile lists 12 months of élevage and 25% new oak.
en.detail: The estate describes fresh fruit and a mineral register, a defined attack and balanced acidity and roundness, followed by a persistent finish.
en.vintageScope: Undated producer specification checked 29 October 2026. Vine ages are the page’s stated averages; élevage and new-oak percentages are not guarantees for every vintage.

wines.imageVintageScope: Official product-page illustration; displayed bottle vintage is not guaranteed to match a purchased bottle.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Les Cloux
wines.place: 朝东陡坡上部，黏土—石灰岩土壤中石灰岩占比较高；网页所列藤龄约35年。为减少侵蚀，限制深耕。Cloux 与由围墙或树篱围合的 clos 一词有关。
wines.method: 酒庄未标年份技术资料：熟成12个月，新橡木桶占25%。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述带柑橘、白色水果、黄油及烘烤香气，口感有结构和圆润度，收结呈矿物调性。酒标用 Les Cloux。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术页，2026-10-29核对；藤龄为网页所述平均值，熟成与新桶比例不作为各年份固定保证。

en.place: East-facing upper slope, steep and limestone-dominant within clay-limestone soils. The page lists about 35-year-old vines. Deep tillage is limited to reduce erosion; Cloux refers to enclosed plots.
en.method: The undated estate profile lists 12 months of élevage and 25% new oak.
en.detail: Estate notes combine citrus and white fruit with buttery and toasted accents, a structured but rounded palate and a mineral finish. The estate labels this wine Les Cloux.
en.vintageScope: Undated producer specification checked 29 October 2026. Vine ages are the page’s stated averages; élevage and new-oak percentages are not guarantees for every vintage.

wines.imageVintageScope: Official product-page illustration; displayed bottle vintage is not guaranteed to match a purchased bottle.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc La Pucelle
wines.place: 朝东、多石坡地，网页所列平均藤龄约40年；酒庄认为该地块长势自然均衡。庄园讲述的幼女获赠佳地故事属于地名传说。
wines.method: 酒庄未标年份技术资料：熟成12个月，新橡木桶占25%。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述为白色水果与柑橘、黄油及烤面包调性；结构清楚而质感圆润，余味较长。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术页，2026-10-29核对；藤龄为网页所述平均值，熟成与新桶比例不作为各年份固定保证。

en.place: Stony east-facing slope with an estate-listed average vine age of about 40 years and naturally balanced growth. The story of a lord granting this parcel to his youngest daughter is presented as local tradition.
en.method: The undated estate profile lists 12 months of élevage and 25% new oak.
en.detail: The estate describes white fruit and citrus, buttery and toasted nuances, clear structure, a rounded texture and a long finish.
en.vintageScope: Undated producer specification checked 29 October 2026. Vine ages are the page’s stated averages; élevage and new-oak percentages are not guarantees for every vintage.

wines.imageVintageScope: Official product-page illustration; displayed bottle vintage is not guaranteed to match a purchased bottle.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Rabourcé
wines.place: 完全朝南的多石黏土—石灰岩地块；网页列平均藤龄约40年。酒庄采用较早采收掌握成熟度，并通过短修剪鼓励植株长势。
wines.method: 酒庄未标年份技术资料：熟成16个月，新橡木桶占25%。
wines.detail: 酒庄描述为较丰厚的白果、香料与烘烤调性，兼具矿物和咸鲜印象。该款熟成为16个月，长于同庄多数白酒网页所列12个月。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术页，2026-10-29核对；藤龄为网页所述平均值，熟成与新桶比例不作为各年份固定保证。

en.place: Fully south-facing, stony clay-limestone parcel with an estate-listed average age of about 40 years. Earlier picking manages ripeness, while shorter pruning supports vine vigour.
en.method: The undated estate profile lists 16 months of élevage and 25% new oak.
en.detail: The estate describes a rich white-fruit profile with spice, toast and mineral-saline accents. Its stated 16-month élevage is longer than the 12 months listed for most of the other estate Rully whites.
en.vintageScope: Undated producer specification checked 29 October 2026. Vine ages are the page’s stated averages; élevage and new-oak percentages are not guarantees for every vintage.

wines.imageVintageScope: Official product-page illustration; displayed bottle vintage is not guaranteed to match a purchased bottle.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Chapitre
wines.place: 中坡黏土—石灰岩地块，网页列藤龄约40年；较充分的地表植被覆盖，配合修剪和抹芽限制长势，追求均衡成熟。

en.intro: A parcel-focused estate centred on Rully, with eleven Rully labels including five white Premiers Crus and Chapitre Rouge Premier Cru. Individual profiles distinguish site, vine-age statements, cultivation and oak regime.
en.scope: All eleven Rully labels in the current official catalogue have been checked. Undated cuvée specifications are distinguished from vintage-specific data.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Founded by the Belleville family in early twentieth-century Rully, the estate expanded into Mercurey and the Côte d’Or. Farming in Monthélie began in 2023.

sections.title: People & ownership
sections.text: The estate history records Swiss-family ownership in 2002 and 2008, followed by acquisition in 2017 by an American couple and director Jean-Luc Vitoux. The page does not name the couple or state shareholdings.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The estate lists 18 ha owned and farmed, plus 4.5 ha in Monthélie taken on in 2023. Rully accounts for 10.5 ha: 8.25 ha Chardonnay and 2.25 ha Pinot Noir. Its five white and one red Premier Cru holdings total more than 4 ha. These are estate-reported figures.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Plots are managed individually. Organic conversion began in 2017; the estate reports certification of its original 18 ha from the 2021 vintage and describes the Monthélie addition as in conversion. Debudding, pruning, cover crops and tillage vary by parcel.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Parcels are vinified and aged separately, with restrained sulphur use and oak management. Rully sheets list either 12 or 16 months of élevage and 15–35% new oak, with the precise specification retained in each wine profile.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: The current catalogue lists eleven Rully wines: eight whites and three reds. The five white Premiers Crus are Chapitre, La Fosse, Les Cloux, La Pucelle and Rabourcé; Chapitre is the red Premier Cru. Village wines comprise three whites and two reds.

producers.name: Domaine de la Folie
producers.intro: Chagny 的家族酒庄，由第五代 Clémence 与 Baptiste Dubrulle 经营。五款 Rully 分别呈现老藤、独占园与罐／桶熟成的差异。
producers.scope: 官网五款Rully已逐款核对，含面积、朝向、栽培、酿造、熟成与酒庄服务建议；未标年份参数保持其原有适用范围。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: 酒庄位于 Chagny、Côte Chalonnaise 北端。家族历史联系包括运动摄影研究者 Étienne-Jules Marey、画家 Victor Bouton 和 Noël-Bouton 家族；酒庄沿用 Bouton 设计的酒标。

sections.title: 人物与传承
sections.text: 第五代 Clémence 与 Baptiste Dubrulle 自2010年经营，分别有公关及工程背景。上一代 Jérôme 与 Elisabeth Noël-Bouton 推动商业及海外发展，并开创 Cuvée Marey。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: Rully 白酒来自 Clos la Folie、Clos du Chaigne 和 Clos Saint-Jacques，后两者为一级园。红酒为 Clos de Bellecroix 及 Cuvée Marey。各页面积和朝向分别记录；Marey与Bellecroix的面积口径不作未经证实的加总。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 五款技术页均列土壤耕作、culture raisonnée及人工小箱采收。这里的culture raisonnée不自动等于有机或生物动力认证；本轮未发现支持该认证说法的官方资料。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 三款白酒低压压榨、细致澄清，并描述酿造阶段不加SO₂。Clos la Folie罐熟；两款白一级园桶熟，新桶20%。红酒全部去梗；Clos de Bellecroix罐熟，Marey桶熟且新桶20%。

sections.title: Rully 酒款
sections.text: 官网Rully目录共五款：三白、两红；五款已保留各自独立档案。酒庄另列Aligoté、Crémant、Ratafia、Marc及黑醋栗利口酒，这些不计为Rully AOP酒款。

en.intro: A family estate in Chagny, run by fifth-generation Clémence and Baptiste Dubrulle. Five Rully wines distinguish old vines, estate monopoles and individual tank or barrel regimes.
en.scope: All five official Rully wines have been checked individually for site, cultivation, cellar methods and estate service guidance. Undated specifications retain their original scope.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Located in Chagny at the northern end of the Côte Chalonnaise, the estate’s family history includes motion-photography researcher Étienne-Jules Marey, painter Victor Bouton and the Noël-Bouton family. Bouton’s label designs remain in use.

sections.title: People & family
sections.text: Fifth-generation Clémence and Baptiste Dubrulle have run the domaine since 2010, following careers in public relations and engineering. Jérôme and Elisabeth Noël-Bouton developed its commercial reach and created Cuvée Marey.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: Rully whites comprise Clos la Folie and the Premiers Crus Clos du Chaigne and Clos Saint-Jacques. Reds are Clos de Bellecroix and Cuvée Marey. Parcel areas and aspects are recorded separately; the relationship between the two red-wine area figures is not assumed.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: All five technical pages state soil cultivation, culture raisonnée and hand harvesting in small crates. Culture raisonnée is not treated as proof of organic or biodynamic certification.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Whites are gently pressed and carefully settled, with vinification described as without SO₂. Clos la Folie is tank-aged; the Premier Cru whites use 20% new oak. Reds are destemmed: Clos de Bellecroix matures in tank and Marey in barrels with 20% new oak.

sections.title: Rully portfolio
sections.text: The official Rully catalogue comprises three whites and two reds, each with its own profile here. Aligoté, Crémant, Ratafia, Marc and blackcurrant liqueur are separate categories and are not counted as Rully AOP wines.

producers.name: Domaine Rois Mages
producers.intro: Anne-Sophie Debavelaere 于 1984 年在 Rully 创立酒庄；儿子 Félix 于 2009 年回归。家族以分地块 Chardonnay 和 Pinot Noir 为核心，兼有 Bouzeron 与 Beaune。
producers.scope: 酒庄与酒款原始资料已逐项核对；技术参数按具体来源和年份解释。

sections.title: 历史与人物
sections.text: 1984 年创立；Félix 受过酿酒学训练，2009 年返庄。2015 年酒窖完成翻新。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 官网现列约 11 ha，分布于 Rully、Bouzeron 与 Beaune；Rully 酒单包含五款白酒、两款红酒。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 各酒款资料分别记录品种、坡向、土壤和藤龄；Les Pierres Rouge 明确注明人工采收与酒窖分选。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 白酒以本土酵母、桶中发酵及酒泥培养为核心；红酒浸渍、罐型和压帽频率按酒款区分。官网通用基准为桶熟 12 个月后在不锈钢罐细酒泥上经历第二个冬季。

sections.title: 酒款组合
sections.text: Rully 村庄级：Plante Moraine、Clos du Moulin à Vent、Les Cailloux Blanc、Chaponnières、Les Cailloux Rouge；一级园：Les Pierres Blanc 与 Rouge。

wines.name: Rully Blanc Plante Moraine
wines.place: 东南向黏土石灰岩地块；未标年份的酒庄资料记载藤龄 34 年，不能直接视为 2026 年藤龄。
wines.method: 气囊压榨、低温澄清及本土酵母；桶中进行酒精和苹果酸乳酸发酵，每日搅桶，合桶前不换桶，装瓶前澄清。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：果味柔和，保持鲜活感与延续性。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Southeast-facing clay-limestone parcel. The undated estate sheet gives vine age as 34 years.
en.method: Pneumatic pressing, cold settling and indigenous yeasts; barrel alcoholic and malolactic fermentation, daily lees stirring, no racking before tank assembly, then fining.
en.detail: Estate description: supple fruit, freshness and a persistent finish.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

wines.imageScope: Estate reference image; not a guarantee of the current vintage label or bottle.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Clos du Moulin à Vent
wines.place: 东南向、黏土占优势；酒庄未标年份资料记载藤龄 35 年。
wines.method: 气囊压榨与低温澄清；本土酵母、桶中发酵及苹果酸乳酸发酵，每两周搅桶；合桶前不换桶，装瓶前澄清。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：成熟果实、奶油及蜡质香气，口感宽厚而持久。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Southeast-facing, clay-dominant site; vine age quoted as 35 years in the undated estate sheet.
en.method: Pneumatic pressing and cold settling; indigenous fermentation and malolactic conversion in barrel, fine lees stirred fortnightly; no racking before tank assembly, followed by fining.
en.detail: Estate profile: ripe fruit, butter and waxy notes, with a broad yet sustained palate.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Les Cailloux
wines.place: Rully 高台上的石灰岩与地表碎石，位置高于一级园坡地，朝东南；未标年份资料记载藤龄约 60 年。
wines.method: 气囊压榨、低温澄清后，以本土酵母在桶中发酵并完成苹果酸乳酸发酵；每两周搅桶，合桶前不换桶，随后澄清。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：花香、较丰厚的结构与鲜活而持久的收结。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Stony limestone on the Rully plateau, above the Premier Cru slopes; southeast-facing. Undated sheet: vines about 60 years old.
en.method: Indigenous yeasts; barrel alcoholic and malolactic fermentation after pneumatic pressing and cold settling. Fine lees stirred fortnightly; no racking before assembly, then fining.
en.detail: Estate description: floral Chardonnay with rich structure and a lively, long finish.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

wines.imageScope: Estate reference image; not a guarantee of the current vintage label or bottle.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Chaponnières
wines.place: 深厚、结构良好的白色黏土石灰岩，东南向；酒庄未标年份资料记载藤龄 50 年。
wines.method: 本土酵母、桶中发酵及苹果酸乳酸发酵，每两周搅桶；资料列 10% 新桶、90% 使用过两至三次的旧桶，装瓶前澄清。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：白花、榅桲、烤杏仁与奶油面包，入口鲜活、收结圆润。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Deep, structured white clay-limestone soil, southeast-facing; undated estate sheet records 50-year-old vines.
en.method: Native-yeast barrel fermentation and malolactic conversion; fortnightly lees stirring. Estate sheet specifies 10% new oak and 90% barrels previously used for two or three wines; fining before bottling.
en.detail: Estate profile: white flowers, quince, toasted almond and brioche; fresh attack and a rounded finish.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Les Pierres
wines.place: 一级园中坡地块，表面碎石、下有黏土层，东南向；未标年份资料记载藤龄 40 年。
wines.method: 气囊压榨、低温澄清与本土酵母；橡木桶中发酵及苹果酸乳酸发酵，每日搅动细酒泥，合桶前不换桶，随后澄清。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：杏仁、洋槐与核果香，余味较长；其一般陈年建议为 3–7 年，需结合年份与储存条件。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Mid-slope Premier Cru, surface stones over clay layers, southeast-facing. Undated sheet records 40-year-old vines.
en.method: Pneumatic pressing, cold settling and indigenous yeasts. Alcoholic and malolactic fermentations in oak on fine lees with daily stirring; no racking before assembly, then fining.
en.detail: Estate description: almond, acacia and stone-fruit character, with extended length. Its general cellaring suggestion is 3–7 years, subject to vintage and storage.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

wines.name: Rully Rouge Les Cailloux
wines.place: 东南向上坡高台，黏土石灰岩含大量碎石；未标年份资料记载藤龄 45 年。
wines.method: 发酵前冷浸渍，本土酵母在混凝土罐发酵；约 15 天内每天两次压帽和淋皮，随后橡木桶熟成一年。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：覆盆子、黑莓果味，木香柔和，质地细滑。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Very stony clay-limestone on a southeast-facing upper-slope plateau; undated sheet gives vine age as 45 years.
en.method: Cold pre-fermentation maceration, indigenous yeasts and concrete-vat fermentation; twice-daily punch-downs and pump-overs over about 15 days, followed by one year in oak.
en.detail: Estate profile: raspberry and blackberry fruit with supple oak and silky texture.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

wines.imageScope: Estate reference image; not a guarantee of the current vintage label or bottle.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Les Pierres
wines.place: Agneux 村落范围内的黏土石灰岩，迎向晨光；未标年份资料记载藤龄 30 年。
wines.method: 人工采收并在酒窖分选；冷浸渍后罐中酿造，压帽与淋皮约 15 天，再于橡木桶熟成 12 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：成熟红黑浆果、胡椒及香料，柔顺且有结构，单宁细滑。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄酒款说明；藤龄保留原文口径，工艺不是所有年份的固定保证。

en.place: Clay-limestone in the Agneux hamlet, facing the rising sun; undated estate sheet records 30-year-old vines.
en.method: Hand-harvested and sorted at the winery; cold soak then tank vinification with punch-downs and pump-overs for 15 days; 12 months in oak.
en.detail: Estate profile: ripe red and black berries, pepper and spice; supple, structured palate with silky tannins.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate wine specification; quoted vine ages are source values, not calculated current ages. Methods may vary by vintage.

en.intro: Founded in Rully by Anne-Sophie Debavelaere in 1984; Félix returned in 2009. The family range focuses on parcel-specific Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, alongside Bouzeron and Beaune.
en.scope: Estate and wine source records reviewed individually; technical details retain their stated source and vintage scope.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: Founded in 1984; oenology-trained Félix returned in 2009. Cellar renovation followed in 2015.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The estate currently states 11 ha across Rully, Bouzeron and Beaune; its Rully list comprises five whites and two reds.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Individual sheets specify variety, aspect, soil and quoted vine age; the Les Pierres red sheet explicitly records hand-harvesting and winery sorting.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Whites use indigenous yeasts, barrel fermentation and lees ageing. Red-vinification details vary by label. The general estate baseline is 12 months in barrel followed by a second winter on fine lees in stainless steel.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: Rully Village: Plante Moraine, Clos du Moulin à Vent, Les Cailloux Blanc, Chaponnières and Les Cailloux Rouge. Premier Cru: Les Pierres Blanc and Rouge.

gaps: Unpublished vintage-specific parameters are not inferred

producers.name: Domaine Jean-Baptiste Ponsot
producers.intro: 1954 年由 Lucien Ponsot 创立，儿子 Bernard 逐步将混合农业转为专门葡萄园经营。Jean-Baptiste 2000 年、20 岁时接手；2005 年新建酒窖/接待空间，增植土地并深化地块研究。与 Sylvain et Lucie Ponsot、Morey-Saint-Denis 的 Domaine Ponsot 均为不同实体。
producers.scope: 酒庄与酒款原始资料已逐项核对；技术参数按具体来源和年份解释。

sections.title: 历史
sections.text: 1954 年由 Lucien Ponsot 创立，儿子 Bernard 逐步将混合农业转为专门葡萄园经营。Jean-Baptiste 2000 年、20 岁时接手；2005 年新建酒窖/接待空间，增植土地并深化地块研究。与 Sylvain et Lucie Ponsot、Morey-Saint-Denis 的 Domaine Ponsot 均为不同实体。

sections.title: 所有权
sections.text: Ponsot 家族，Jean-Baptiste 独立经营。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 官网约 8.8 ha：Rully Premier Cru 5.10 ha，Village 3.36 ha，Aligoté 0.21 ha、Chassagne-Montrachet 0.08 ha。官网该分项合计 8.75 ha，是四舍五入，Molesme 3.05 ha（Chardonnay 1.30、Pinot Noir 1.75）；Montpalais 1.71 ha；En Bas de Vauvry 3.03 ha 属 Village。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 2007 年起禁止除草剂/杀虫剂等，修剪与叶幕及草生管理按园变化；官网表述 culture raisonnée，不等于取得有机证书。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 红酒双重分选，发酵前冷浸约 4–6 天，总浸渍约 21 天；白酒压榨后澄清约 24 小时，再入桶发酵。逐款技术页的培养比例列入各酒款；Raclot 独立资料未给出的参数不从其他酒款推算。

sections.title: 酒款组合
sections.text: 现列 Rully Village Blanc En Bas de Vauvry 与 Rouge；一级园包括 Molesme 红白、Montpalais 白、La Fosse 红，以及由 2022 年酒标和独立酒款资料确认的 Raclot 白。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Molesme
wines.place: Molesme 一级园总地块 3.05 ha，Chardonnay 占 1.30 ha。东至东南向，牛津阶鲕粒及致密石灰岩。
wines.method: Guyot 修剪；橡木桶熟成 12 个月，资料列 25% 新桶，随后合桶静置约 3 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：丰厚质地与鲜明张力并存，余味持久。酒庄建议约 11°C 饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术说明；优先采用逐款比例，不将通用木桶比例套用于全部酒。

en.place: Molesme covers 3.05 ha in the family holding, including 1.30 ha Chardonnay; east to southeast exposure over Oxfordian oolitic and compact limestone.
en.method: Guyot-trained vines; 12 months in oak with 25% new barrels, followed by approximately three months after assembly.
en.detail: Estate style: textured yet energetic, with sustained length. Suggested service: about 11°C.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate technical profile. Individual wine proportions take precedence over estate-wide summaries; vintage-specific variations remain possible.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge Molesme
wines.place: Molesme 一级园中 Pinot Noir 约 1.75 ha；家族自 1954 年持有，分批种植记录为 1978–2011 年。
wines.method: Guyot 与 Cordon 修剪；桶熟 12 个月，资料列 40% 新桶，随后合桶约 3 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：果味充沛、质地细滑、单宁包裹感强；建议约 16°C 饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术说明；优先采用逐款比例，不将通用木桶比例套用于全部酒。

en.place: The Molesme holding includes about 1.75 ha Pinot Noir. Family ownership dates to 1954; recorded plantings extend from 1978 to 2011.
en.method: Guyot and Cordon training; 12 months in barrel with 40% new oak, then approximately three months after assembly.
en.detail: Estate style: generous fruit, a velvety texture and rounded tannins. Suggested service: about 16°C.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate technical profile. Individual wine proportions take precedence over estate-wide summaries; vintage-specific variations remain possible.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Montpalais
wines.place: 家族自 1952 年持有约 1.71 ha，1954 年种植 Chardonnay；东至东南向陡坡，白色泥灰岩与石灰岩，需防止侵蚀。
wines.method: Guyot 修剪；桶熟 12 个月，资料列 20% 新桶，再合桶静置约 3 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：燧石调性与较长余味；建议约 11°C 饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术说明；优先采用逐款比例，不将通用木桶比例套用于全部酒。

en.place: Family holding of about 1.71 ha since 1952, planted in Chardonnay in 1954; steep east to southeast slope, white marl and limestone, requiring erosion control.
en.method: Guyot pruning; 12 months in oak with 20% new barrels, then approximately three months after assembly.
en.detail: Estate style: flinty character and length. Suggested service: about 11°C.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate technical profile. Individual wine proportions take precedence over estate-wide summaries; vintage-specific variations remain possible.

wines.name: Rully Blanc En Bas de Vauvry
wines.place: 村庄级，不能因邻近一级园而升格。家族地块 3.03 ha，2000–2009 年栽植，东至东南向，石灰质泥灰岩。
wines.method: 酒款资料列 12 个月培养，再合桶 3 个月；其中 15% 罐体、20% 新桶，其余为使用过一至四次的木桶。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：干型、适度烘烤香、口感带奶油质感；建议约 11°C 饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术说明；优先采用逐款比例，不将通用木桶比例套用于全部酒。

en.place: Village-level wine, despite its position among Premier Cru slopes. The family parcel is 3.03 ha, planted 2000–2009; east to southeast aspect with calcareous marl.
en.method: The wine sheet lists 12 months of ageing and three months after assembly: 15% tank, 20% new oak, with the balance in barrels used for one to four wines.
en.detail: Estate style: dry, gently toasted and creamy-textured. Suggested service: about 11°C.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate technical profile. Individual wine proportions take precedence over estate-wide summaries; vintage-specific variations remain possible.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: 酒款页标 En Bas de Vauvry；酒庄地块总览还将 Brange 列入这款村庄级红酒来源，Brange 约 0.33 ha、1958 年种植。
wines.method: Guyot 修剪；桶熟 12 个月，资料列 30% 新桶，随后合桶静置约 3 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：成熟果味和圆润单宁；建议约 16°C 饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术说明；优先采用逐款比例，不将通用木桶比例套用于全部酒。

en.place: The wine page names En Bas de Vauvry; the estate parcel overview also associates Brange with this Village red. Brange is about 0.33 ha, planted in 1958.
en.method: Guyot pruning; 12 months in oak, 30% new, followed by approximately three months after assembly.
en.detail: Estate style: ripe fruit and rounded tannins. Suggested service: about 16°C.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate technical profile. Individual wine proportions take precedence over estate-wide summaries; vintage-specific variations remain possible.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Rouge La Fosse
wines.place: 约 0.25 ha，1969 年种植 Pinot Noir，2006 年起租种；东南向牛津阶石灰岩地块。
wines.method: Cordon 修剪与行间草生；桶熟 12 个月，资料列 40% 新桶，再合桶静置约 3 个月。
wines.detail: 酒庄风格描述：花香与鲜活果味，结构适合培养；建议约 17°C 饮用。
wines.vintageScope: 未标年份的酒庄技术说明；优先采用逐款比例，不将通用木桶比例套用于全部酒。

en.place: Approximately 0.25 ha of Pinot Noir planted in 1969, rented since 2006; southeast-facing Oxfordian limestone parcel.
en.method: Cordon training and grass between rows; 12 months in oak with 40% new barrels, followed by three months after assembly.
en.detail: Estate style: floral, fresh-fruited and structured for development. Suggested service: about 17°C.
en.vintageScope: Undated estate technical profile. Individual wine proportions take precedence over estate-wide summaries; vintage-specific variations remain possible.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Raclot
wines.place: Raclot，邻近 Cloux 的陡坡；2022 年酒款商家技术说明记载东向、泥灰岩和褐色石灰岩，表层黏土粉砂。
wines.method: 2022 年酒款资料确认品种和产地，但没有提供发酵容器、新桶比例或熟成时长；不能直接套用其他 Ponsot 酒款参数。
wines.detail: 2022 年商家品鉴描述强调浓集白色果实、柑橘、香料与紧密结构。Raclot 为独立一级园酒款，不是 Molesme 或 Montpalais 的别名。
wines.vintageScope: 地块及品鉴信息对应 2022 年，RVF 另列 2024 年；不将 2022 年描述当作所有年份恒定风格。

en.place: Raclot, beside Cloux on a steep slope. The 2022 merchant sheet describes an easterly aspect, marl and brown limestone with a clay-silt surface.
en.method: The 2022 sheet confirms variety and origin but does not provide fermentation vessels, new-oak percentage or ageing duration. Other Ponsot wine specifications cannot be substituted.
en.detail: The merchant’s 2022 note describes concentrated white fruit, citrus, spice and a dense structure. Raclot is a separate Premier Cru wine, not an alias of Molesme or Montpalais.
en.vintageScope: Site and tasting description refer to 2022; RVF also lists 2024. The tasting description is not a specification for every vintage.

en.intro: Founded in 1954 by Lucien Ponsot and expanded by his son Bernard. Jean-Baptiste took over in 2000 and built new cellar facilities in 2005. Separate from Sylvain et Lucie Ponsot and Domaine Ponsot in Morey-Saint-Denis.
en.scope: Estate and wine source records reviewed individually; technical details retain their stated source and vintage scope.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Founded in 1954 by Lucien Ponsot and expanded by his son Bernard. Jean-Baptiste took over in 2000 and built new cellar facilities in 2005. Separate from Sylvain et Lucie Ponsot and Domaine Ponsot in Morey-Saint-Denis.

sections.title: Ownership
sections.text: Independent Jean-Baptiste Ponsot family estate.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: Website c.8.8 ha (subparts 5.10 Premier Cru, 3.36 Village, 0.21 Aligoté, 0.08 Chassagne = 8.75 ha due to rounding). Molesme 3.05 ha across both varieties; Montpalais 1.71 ha; En Bas de Vauvry 3.03 ha is Village despite the RVF article listing 1er Cru.

sections.title: Viticulture

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Reds undergo two sorting stages, about four to six days of cold soak and around 21 days total vatting. Whites settle for roughly 24 hours before barrel fermentation. Individual wine specifications are recorded separately; missing Raclot parameters are not inferred from other labels.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: Rully Village En Bas de Vauvry Blanc and Rouge; Premier Cru Molesme in both colours, Montpalais Blanc, La Fosse Rouge, plus Raclot Blanc confirmed by the 2022 label and independent wine documentation.

en.intro: The Grandmougin family acquired Domaine Saint-Jacques in 1955. Based in Rully, it is a reference for Marissou, La Fosse and the separate Stellaris Campus selections.
en.scope: Estate and wine source records reviewed individually; technical details retain their stated source and vintage scope.

sections.title: History & people
sections.text: Family ownership dates from 1955; Christophe has managed the estate since 1991. Historic buildings are associated with the Saint-Jacques pilgrimage route and retain Romanesque cellars.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The Rully holdings include Chardonnay and Pinot Noir in Marissou, La Fosse and Village parcels, plus Aligoté. Holdings of different colours are recorded separately.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The estate describes sustainable farming, mechanical weed control, bud thinning, crop thinning, canopy management and manual harvest. This is not a claim of organic certification.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: The estate publishes separate house baselines for reds and whites and adapts vinification by vintage. Dedicated Stellaris Campus technical parameters are not separately published.

sections.title: Portfolio
sections.text: Source-listed wines are Rully Blanc, Marissou in both colours, La Fosse Rouge and white/red Stellaris Campus. The recorded La Fosse white holding contributes to Stellaris Blanc; a vineyard entry alone does not establish a separate current label.

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: Rully 村庄级；黏土石灰岩土壤。
wines.method: 人工采收、整串气囊压榨；12°C 静置 24 小时。桶与 demi-muids 中完成酒精及苹果酸乳酸发酵；轻烘烤法国桶 15 个月，20% 新桶，定期搅桶。
wines.detail: 官网建议 11–13°C 侍酒，搭配白肉、禽肉或鱼。
wines.vintageScope: 页面列 2023；工艺作为酒款技术基线，不视为所有年份保证。

en.place: Village Rully on clay-limestone soils.
en.method: Hand harvest, whole-bunch pneumatic press, 24-hour settling at 12°C; alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in barrels/demi-muids. Fifteen months in lightly toasted French oak, 20% new, with regular bâtonnage.
en.detail: Producer suggests 11–13°C and white meat, poultry or fish.
en.vintageScope: Page lists 2023; process is treated as a label baseline, not a guarantee for all vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Grésigny
wines.place: Mont Palais 坡地；多石的黏土石灰岩土壤。
wines.method: 人工采收，整串压榨、12°C 静置 24 小时；桶中酒精及苹果酸乳酸发酵。轻烘烤法国桶 18 个月，30% 新桶。
wines.detail: 官网建议 11–13°C；适合贝类与甲壳类。
wines.vintageScope: 页面列 2023；技术文字未注明仅适用该年份。

en.place: On the slopes of Mont Palais, with stony clay-limestone soils.
en.method: Hand-picked and whole-bunch pressed; 24-hour settling at 12°C, then alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in barrel. Eighteen months in lightly toasted French oak, 30% new.
en.detail: Producer suggests 11–13°C with shellfish.
en.vintageScope: Page lists 2023; technical text is not explicitly limited to that vintage.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: Rully 村庄级，黏土石灰岩土壤。
wines.method: 人工采收、小筐运输、分选及去梗；10°C 冷浸，8–10 天每日压帽，再浸渍 3–5 天。完成苹果酸乳酸发酵；法国桶 15 个月，20% 新桶。
wines.detail: 官网建议 17°C；酒款以 Pinot Noir 酿制。
wines.vintageScope: 页面同时列 2018、2022、2023；工艺为酒款基线。

en.place: Village Rully on clay-limestone soils.
en.method: Hand-picked into small crates, sorted and destemmed; cold soak at 10°C, daily punch-downs for 8–10 days and a further 3–5-day maceration. Complete malolactic conversion; 15 months in French oak, 20% new.
en.detail: Producer serving recommendation: 17°C; Pinot Noir.
en.vintageScope: Page lists 2018, 2022 and 2023; method is a label-level baseline.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Founded by Lucien Ponsot in 1954; Raymond succeeded him, Sylvain took over in 1996 and Lucie joined in 2016.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The website records over 6 ha overall, including about 5.5 ha of Rully Premier Cru. This is a separate estate from Jean-Baptiste Ponsot.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Agriculture raisonnée without herbicides, with soil cultivation, canopy work and yield control.

sections.title: Winemaking and ageing
sections.text: Whites generally mature 15–20 months according to vintage. Vessels include barrels, a 1,200 L foudre and 373 L terracotta amphora. Reds receive temperature control and gentle extraction, with cuvée-specific oak.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Jean Daux settled in Rully in 1983, continuing a family-growing tradition. The estate operates under Vincent Daux at 21 Rue de Geley.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: BIVB records 18 ha and an overall 67% white / 33% red split; these figures are not blend percentages.

sections.title: Winemaking and ageing
sections.text: Maizières and La Gaudine use tanks; Les Gaudoirs undergoes prolonged foudre fermentation. Reds are sorted, destemmed and cold-soaked with temperature-controlled fermentation; ageing vessels vary by cuvée.

producers.name: Domaine des Chauchoux
producers.intro: Belleville 家族在 Rully 经营的第四代酒庄；官网以 1926 年 André Belleville 购入酒窖为起点，2026 年庆祝百年。
producers.scope: 已核对来源的酒庄与 Rully 酒款档案；非年份技术基线与指定年份记录分开。

sections.title: 历史与身份
sections.text: Henry Belleville 继承后转向静止酒；Christian 于 1982 年接手。历史上的 Manigley 与 Chauchoux 葡萄园现结合经营，不与另一个 Domaine Belleville 档案合并。

sections.title: 葡萄园
sections.text: 官网列 21 ha，BIVB 简介列约 20 ha；面积为酒庄整体，包含非 Rully 酒款。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 酒庄自行种植、酿造及销售；官网给出总体橡木桶熟成 8–10 个月，酒窖建于 1826 年。未公布逐款新桶比例。

en.intro: A fourth-generation Rully estate of the Belleville family, celebrating its centenary in 2026 from André Belleville's 1926 purchase of the cellars.
en.scope: Source-reviewed producer and Rully wine records; label-level technical baselines are separated from identified vintages.

sections.title: History and identity
sections.text: Henry Belleville shifted towards still wines; Christian took over in 1982. Historic Manigley and Chauchoux vineyards are now combined; this estate is not merged with the separate Domaine Belleville profile.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: The estate website states 21 ha, versus about 20 ha in BIVB's profile; this is total estate area including non-Rully wines.

sections.title: Winemaking and ageing
sections.text: The estate grows, makes and markets its wines. Its general method specifies 8–10 months in oak and cellars dating to 1826; individual new-oak percentages are not published.

producers.name: Domaine Eric de Suremain
producers.intro: 位于 Monthelie 的家族酒庄，经营约 10 ha 的 Monthelie 与 Rully 葡萄园；Rully 系列包含多个 Chardonnay 一级园和 Préaux Pinot Noir。
producers.scope: Rully 酒款与对应来源；酒庄整体栽培及工艺另注明适用范围。

sections.title: 身份与历史
sections.text: Monthelie 的家族酒庄；现由 Eric、Dominique 与女儿 Gwendoline 共同经营，Gwendoline 于 2019 年回归。

sections.title: 葡萄园与栽培
sections.text: 约 10 ha 横跨 Monthelie 与 Rully；全部 Chardonnay 位于 Rully。官网称葡萄园有机认证，1996 年起实践生物动力法。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 白酒轻压榨、静置后桶发酵，通常熟成约 15 个月；红酒在酒精发酵后入桶进行苹果酸乳酸发酵，桶熟 18–20 个月。这是酒庄基线，具体年份可不同。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Agneux
wines.place: Agneux 一级园；2023 年官方酒单将其 2020 白酒列为 monopole。
wines.method: 酒庄白酒基线：分选、轻破碎、立式木框压榨；静置 3–4 天后入 228 L 桶发酵，约 15 个月熟成，期间搅桶及添桶。新桶比例未披露。
wines.detail: 2019 年酒庄品鉴描述为白花、成熟果味、丰富口感与清新酸度；这不是 2022 的品鉴笔记。
wines.vintageScope: 身份年份：2022。其他年份品鉴与未标年份酒庄工艺分别标注；不将旧酒单价格或库存当作当前信息。

en.place: Agneux Premier Cru; the 2023 estate list calls its 2020 white a monopole.
en.method: Estate white-wine baseline: sorting, light crushing, vertical pressing and 3–4 days settling; fermentation and about 15 months maturation in 228 L barrels, with lees stirring and topping. New-oak share is unspecified.
en.detail: The estate’s 2019 note describes floral aromas, ripe fruit, volume and freshness; it is not a tasting of 2022.
en.vintageScope: Identity reference: 2022. Older tasting notes and undated estate methods retain their stated scope; historic prices and stock are not treated as current.

wines.method: 酒庄白酒基线：分选、轻破碎、立式木框压榨；静置 3–4 天后入 228 L 桶发酵，约 15 个月熟成，期间搅桶及添桶。新桶比例未披露。
wines.detail: 该 Chardonnay 与 Le Meix Cadot 为不同一级园。酒庄强调张力与细致度；2020 酒款身份见其 2023 年酒单。
wines.vintageScope: 身份年份：2020。其他年份品鉴与未标年份酒庄工艺分别标注；不将旧酒单价格或库存当作当前信息。

en.detail: This Chardonnay comes from a different climat from Le Meix Cadot. The estate emphasizes tension and finesse; its 2023 list documents the 2020 release.
en.vintageScope: Identity reference: 2020. Older tasting notes and undated estate methods retain their stated scope; historic prices and stock are not treated as current.

en.scope: Rully wines with dated evidence; estate-level farming and cellar methods are labelled separately.

sections.title: Identity and history
sections.text: A family estate in Monthelie, run by Eric, Dominique and daughter Gwendoline, who returned in 2019.

sections.title: Vineyards and farming
sections.text: Approximately 10 ha across Monthelie and Rully; all estate Chardonnay is in Rully. The estate reports organic certification and biodynamic practice since 1996.

sections.title: Vinification and élevage
sections.text: Estate baseline: whites ferment in barrel after pressing and settling, then mature for about 15 months. Reds enter barrel after alcoholic fermentation, undergo malolactic fermentation and mature for 18–20 months. Vintage choices may differ.

producers.name: Domaine de la Bressande
producers.intro: 2016 年创立的 Côte Chalonnaise 酒庄，经营 Rully、Mercurey 及 Hautes-Côtes de Beaune 葡萄园。Anne-Laure Hernette 负责酿造，Rully 酒款涵盖村庄级、多个一级园及 Vignes du Château de Rully 系列。
producers.scope: 已核对来源的酒庄与 Rully 酒款档案；非年份技术基线与指定年份记录分开。

sections.title: 规模与葡萄园
sections.text: 当前酒庄总览列超过 70 ha，涵盖多个产区。方法页另记 Rully 约 21.57 ha、14 个地块；各页面统计口径与更新时间不同，不能将总面积都视为 Rully。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 酒庄称自 2020 年份获得 HVE 认证，采用产量控制、审慎植保及生物防治产品；HVE 不等于有机认证。

sections.title: 酿酒团队
sections.text: Anne-Laure Hernette 与葡萄园团队共同制定栽培方案，并负责酿造、熟成和调配。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 红酒多去梗，在温控混凝土罐中发酵；白酒先压榨并冷沉淀，再于不锈钢罐开始发酵。桶陈、新桶比例与酒泥管理按具体年份酒款记录。

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Molesme Blanc — Vignes du Château de Rully
wines.place: Château 葡萄园的 0.5 ha 南向 Chardonnay；棕色钙质土、坡脚粉土及 Oxfordian 石灰岩。
wines.method: 2024 年 9 月 20 日采收；气囊压榨、冷沉淀 48 小时，不锈钢罐发酵后入桶。228 L 桶细酒泥熟成 9 个月，30% 新桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 风格记录：花香、烤面包与持久口感。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: South-facing 0.5 ha of Château Chardonnay, with brown calcareous soil, footslope silt and Oxfordian limestone.
en.method: Harvested 20 September 2024; pneumatic pressing, 48-hour cold settling and stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Nine months on fine lees in 228 L barrels, 30% new.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: flowers, toast and persistence.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Clos de la Bressande Monopole — Vignes du Château de Rully
wines.place: 城堡脚下 2.60 ha 围墙葡萄园，东南向，黏土石灰岩。
wines.method: 9 月 20 日采收；气囊压榨，12°C 冷沉淀 24 小时；13–18°C 不锈钢罐起发，发酵中转桶。228 L 桶及少量 500 L 桶细酒泥熟成 8 个月，至 MLF 前每周搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述蜂蜜与烘烤香，酒体丰厚、余味长。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Southeast-facing 2.60 ha walled vineyard below the château, on clay-limestone.
en.method: Harvested 20 September; pneumatic press, 24-hour settling at 12°C; fermentation starts in stainless steel at 13–18°C and continues after transfer. Eight months on fine lees in mostly 228 L and some 500 L barrels; weekly stirring until MLF.
en.detail: Producer describes honey and toast, generous texture and length.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Blanc — Vignes du Château de Rully
wines.place: Château 系列村庄级白酒；4.12 ha 棕色石灰质土，页面平均树龄约 20 年。
wines.method: 气囊压榨、冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期转桶。细酒泥熟成 9 个月，约 20% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述金银花、融合的木香与果味。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Château-labelled village white; 4.12 ha on brown calcareous soil, with vines averaging about 20 years in the source.
en.method: Pneumatic press and 16–24-hour cold settling; transferred from stainless steel near fermentation's end. Nine months on fine lees, about 20% new oak; stirring roughly twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer describes honeysuckle, integrated oak and fruit.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Chapitre Rouge
wines.place: Rully 北部、朝 Chagny 的坡地；酒庄 0.18 ha，棕色石灰质土，页面树龄约 15 年。
wines.method: 2022 年 8 月 29 日人工采收、小筐运输及分选；温控混凝土罐，每日淋皮、少量压帽。桶陈 8 个月，约 25% 新桶，装瓶前过滤。
wines.detail: 生产者 2022 描述红黑水果、包裹感与融合的橡木。
wines.vintageScope: 2022 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Northern Rully slopes towards Chagny; estate parcel 0.18 ha on brown calcareous soil, source vine age about 15 years.
en.method: Hand-picked on 29 August 2022, transported in small crates and sorted. Temperature-controlled concrete, daily pump-overs and little punching down; eight months in oak, about 25% new, followed by filtration.
en.detail: Producer's 2022 note: red and black fruit, rounded texture and integrated oak.
en.vintageScope: Official 2022 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Grésigny Blanc
wines.place: 0.7 ha，强钙质棕色土；2021 页面树龄约 27 年。
wines.method: 9 月 27 日采收，气囊压榨，冷沉淀 12–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期转桶。细酒泥熟成 8 个月，25% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2021 描述蜂蜜、花香和柔顺饱满的口感。
wines.vintageScope: 2021 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 0.7 ha on strongly calcareous brown soil; the 2021 page gives vine age around 27 years.
en.method: Harvested 27 September; pneumatic pressing, 12–24-hour cold settling, then stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Eight months on fine lees, 25% new oak; twice-monthly stirring until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2021 note: honey, flowers and supple richness.
en.vintageScope: Official 2021 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru La Pucelle Blanc
wines.place: 1.5 ha；棕色石灰质、多石土壤及少量黏土坡积物，页面树龄约 40 年。
wines.method: 人工采收，气囊压榨及冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期转桶。228 L 桶细酒泥熟成 9 个月，25% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述柑橘、细致木香及紧致长余味。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 1.5 ha with stony brown calcareous soils and some clay colluvium; source vine age about 40 years.
en.method: Hand harvest, pneumatic pressing and 16–24-hour cold settling; stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Nine months on fine lees in 228 L barrels, 25% new; stirring roughly twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: citrus, fine oak and a taut, persistent finish.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Molesme Rouge
wines.place: 约 3 ha Pinot Noir，东至东南向的平缓坡脚；Oxfordian 石灰岩。与 Château 系列白 Molesme 分开。
wines.method: 人工采收及两次分选；温控混凝土罐、每日淋皮、少量压帽。橡木桶 8 个月，25% 新桶，轻过滤装瓶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述樱桃、白胡椒、烘烤及烟草。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: About 3 ha of Pinot Noir on an east-southeast-facing footslope over Oxfordian limestone; separate from Château Molesme white.
en.method: Hand harvest and two-stage sorting; temperature-controlled concrete, daily pump-overs and little punching down. Eight months in oak, 25% new; lightly filtered.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: cherry, white pepper, toast and tobacco.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Préaux Rouge
wines.place: 1.50 ha，棕色多石石灰质土；2023 页面记树龄约 53 年。
wines.method: 9 月 13 日人工采收；2023 工艺段记冷浸 72 小时、浸渍 14–20 天，温控混凝土罐中每日淋皮并少量压帽。桶陈 8 个月，25% 新桶，过滤装瓶。
wines.detail: 生产者描述胡椒、花香、黑醋栗及清新感。
wines.vintageScope: 2023 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 1.50 ha on stony brown calcareous soil; the 2023 page gives vine age about 53 years.
en.method: Hand-picked 13 September; the explicit 2023 method specifies 72-hour cold soak and 14–20-day maceration, temperature-controlled concrete, daily pump-overs and some punching down. Eight months in oak, 25% new; filtered.
en.detail: Producer describes pepper, flowers, blackcurrant and freshness.
en.vintageScope: Official 2023 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: 三块葡萄园合计 2.6 ha，黏土石灰岩；页面平均树龄 30 年。与 Château 系列村庄白独立建档。
wines.method: 人工采收、气囊压榨及冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期入 228 L 桶。细酒泥熟成 9 个月，20% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述金银花、果味与融合的木香。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Three parcels totalling 2.6 ha on clay-limestone; source average vine age 30 years. Separate from the Château-labelled village white.
en.method: Hand-picked and pneumatically pressed; 16–24-hour settling, stainless-steel fermentation and transfer to 228 L barrels. Nine months on fine lees, 20% new oak; stirring about twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: honeysuckle, fruit and integrated oak.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Rouge
wines.place: 1.21 ha Pinot Noir，棕色多石石灰质土；页面树龄约 25 年。
wines.method: 人工采收、小筐运输，温控混凝土罐发酵，每日淋皮与少量压帽。桶陈 8 个月，约 20% 新桶，装瓶前过滤。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述红黑水果、烘烤与细致但清晰的单宁。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: 1.21 ha of Pinot Noir on stony brown calcareous soil; source vine age about 25 years.
en.method: Hand harvest into small crates; temperature-controlled concrete fermentation with daily pump-overs and little punching down. Eight months in oak, about 20% new; filtered before bottling.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: red and black fruit, toast and fine but present tannins.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

wines.name: Rully Saint-Jacques Blanc
wines.place: 村庄级，1.5 ha 黏土、粉土及石灰质土；页面树龄约 30 年。
wines.method: 9 月 19 日采收，直接压榨及冷沉淀 16–24 小时；不锈钢罐发酵末期入桶。细酒泥熟成 8 个月，25% 新桶；至 MLF 前每月约两次搅桶。
wines.detail: 生产者 2024 描述梨、菠萝、紫罗兰、轻木香及饱满酒体。
wines.vintageScope: 2024 年份官方记录；面积与树龄均按该页面口径，工艺不自动外推至其他年份。

en.place: Village-level 1.5 ha on clay-silt-limestone soil; source vine age about 30 years.
en.method: Harvested 19 September, directly pressed and cold-settled 16–24 hours; stainless-steel fermentation before barrelling. Eight months on fine lees, 25% new oak; stirring about twice monthly until MLF.
en.detail: Producer's 2024 note: pear, pineapple, violet, gentle oak and breadth.
en.vintageScope: Official 2024 record; parcel figures and vine ages are as published, and methods are not transferred to other vintages.

en.intro: Founded in 2016, this Côte Chalonnaise estate works Rully, Mercurey and Hautes-Côtes de Beaune vineyards. Winemaker Anne-Laure Hernette oversees village and Premier Cru Rully wines, including the distinct Vignes du Château de Rully range.
en.scope: Source-reviewed producer and Rully wine records; label-level technical baselines are separated from identified vintages.

sections.title: Scale and vineyards
sections.text: The current estate overview gives over 70 ha across several appellations. The methods page separately records 21.57 ha in 14 Rully parcels; figures from different pages are not interchangeable.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: The estate reports HVE certification from the 2020 vintage, yield control, reasoned protection and biocontrol products; HVE is not organic certification.

sections.title: Winemaking team
sections.text: Anne-Laure Hernette works with the vineyard team and directs vinification, ageing and blending.

sections.title: Winemaking and ageing
sections.text: Reds are mainly destemmed and fermented in temperature-controlled concrete. Whites are pressed, cold-settled and begin fermentation in stainless steel. Oak, lees management and timing are recorded by wine and vintage.
